title: Engineering Technician- Power Electronics
description:
Company Overview

Amperesand is reinventing how the world powers its most critical systems.

We are facing a once-in-a-generation opportunity for infrastructure disruption. Electricity demand is skyrocketing, driven by AI factories, electric vehicles, and modern industrial growth. Energy supply is shifting to incorporate a more diverse mix of resources – including solar, gas, and batteries – at a massive scale.

And yet the power infrastructure behind our latest mega-projects hasn’t meaningfully changed in nearly 100 years. Supply chains for today’s infrastructure equipment can’t match the pace and sophistication of critical energy projects. Amperesand is building hardware and software that rewrites this broken power infrastructure playbook to support a new era of energy abundance.

We’ve built a new class of intelligent, software-defined power infrastructure products leveraging a decade of advanced medium voltage Solid State Transformer research that’s now ready for commercial deployment.

Our products and solutions go far beyond the capabilities of traditional electrical equipment. We make power systems that are faster to deploy, dramatically smaller and more efficient, and capable of supporting modern, dynamic energy needs for tomorrow’s most demanding energy consumers.

Scalable in-house advanced manufacturing capability is our foundation for meeting timeline and quality expectation to serve infrastructure customers around the world.

Amperesand is led by breakthrough energy hardware development veterans and funded by top tier investors who share our vision of building a category-defining energy technology company.

With hubs in San Francisco, Reno, and Singapore, our global team is laser focused on building foundational technology to solve the most pressing problems in power infrastructure at scale.

Join us in building the power foundation of the future!

Role Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Engineering Technician to support mechanical and electrical assembly, NPI product builds, and prototype equipment setup. This role plays a critical part in the development and launch of new products and systems, requiring a blend of craftsmanship, technical acumen, and team collaboration. The ideal candidate has a passion for building, testing, and refining electro-mechanical systems in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Assemble electro-mechanical systems, pilot equipment, and new product builds (NPI) with a high degree of precision and quality.

  • Support installation, wiring, and commissioning of manufacturing and pilot equipment, including conveyors, fixtures, and automation platforms.

  • Perform manual fabrication of brackets, fixtures, and wiring harnesses; including soldering, crimping, and machining tasks.

  • Read and interpret electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, and work instructions to guide builds and troubleshooting.

  • Collaborate with engineers on prototype iterations, test fixture development, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Assist in product and process validation activities, including execution of qualification protocols and data collection.

  • Operate lab tools and test equipment (meters, scopes, DAQs) to verify system performance and identify faults.

  • Document assembly procedures, test results, findings, and provide clear feedback on potential design improvements.

  • Maintain organization of the lab and tool spaces, support shipping/logistics and manage incoming parts and prototype inventory.

  • Ensure adherence to safety standards and protocols, especially when working with high-voltage or mechanical systems.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED required.

  • 4–5+ years of experience in assembly, testing, or support of electro-mechanical equipment or NPI builds.

  • Proficient with hand tools, power tools, shear, breaker, hydraulic press, and manual fabrication techniques; machine shop experience is a plus.

  • Basic understanding of electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic systems, including ability to troubleshoot and rework.

  • Experience with CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD) and interpreting technical drawings.

  • Demonstrated ability to read and work from electromechanical diagrams or multi-discipline engineering documentation.

  • Experience contributing to design for manufacturability (DFM) reviews and feedback loops with engineering teams.

  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs, stand or bend for extended periods, and operate safely in an industrial lab setting.

  • Communicate collaboratively across cross-functional teams

  • Familiarity with PLC systems, HMI/SCADA, Python, or data analysis tools is a plus.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Associate’s degree in a technical discipline (e.g., mechanical, electrical, manufacturing technology) or equivalent hands-on experience preferred.

  • Proficiency in 3D EXPERIENCE, CATIA, and SolidWorks for interpreting and working with complex CAD models.

  • Strong foundation in electrical systems and controls

  • Experience with medium-voltage (5 kV to 36 kV) systems, and power electronics.

  • Prior experience in NPI builds, pilot lines, or early-stage product validation.

  • Experience working in Agile development environments, including task management and sprint planning using Scrum methodologies and tools like Jira.

Please note: This role requires working on-site 5 days a week. We do not offer hybrid or remote options.

Pay Disclosure & Benefits

Compensation will be determined based on experience, location, and other factors permitted by law.

The benefits outlined below apply exclusively to employees located in the United States.

  • Competitive Salary + Incentive Stock Options
  • Medical, vision, and dental benefits for employees and their dependents, effective from the start of hire
  • Company paid Basic Life, AD&D, short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • 401k retirement savings plan through Empower
  • Employees receive paid time off (PTO), paid sick days, and paid company holidays
  • Commuter Benefits
  • 100% paid maternal leave (12 weeks) and paternal leave (6 weeks)

Singapore-based employees receive benefits in accordance with local government provisions.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Amperesand is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Amperesand is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

title: Post Producer
description:
About Early Media

Early Media is a media company building both scripted and unscripted video content for kids, teen and young adult audiences. On the scripted side, we produce vertical drama series with real viral potential and mass appeal, distributed through our own mobile-first streaming app. We strive to preserve the craft and heart of indie production while making content young audiences actually care about. On the unscripted side, we create weekly content that supports Level, our parent learning platform, blending entertainment with real educational value to help students build academic and life skills with confidence and joy.

We're hiring a Post Producer to run the day-to-day post-production management across our scripted and unscripted slates, working directly with the Director of Post. You will manage all of our projects from ingest to delivery, and support the editors and finishing artists.

What you'll own

  • Scheduling & status: Owning the schedule and status of every active project in post: scripted drama, unscripted series, and pilots.

  • Resource management: Knowing who's working on what, ensuring editors are available when jobs need them, and reallocating capacity when projects run behind or timelines compress. Includes coordinating and managing external vendors.

  • Frontline creative feedback: You are the first person to see the editors work and you are comfortable giving notes to ensure when the videos get shared to stakeholders they are aligned with the vision for the content.

  • Feedback loop: Owning the loop between post and internal stakeholders: making sure notes arrive on time, are understood and correctly implemented, and that the downstream implications of changes are flagged before they cause problems.

  • Budget: Owning the post budget at the project level: actuals, purchase orders, and flagging overages before they happen.

  • Operational foundation: Alongside the Director of Post, building and maintaining the department's operational backbone: workflow standards, naming conventions, documentation, and the project management system, keeping it accurate as the slate grows.

Must-haves

  • Proven project management skills: Comfortable keeping many moving parts (schedules, people, vendors, budgets) working together without dropping the ball

  • Multi-project experience: You've tracked simultaneous projects across different phases of post at once with different timelines and resources.

  • Deep understanding of the post-production process: You’re able to spot issues or bottlenecks ahead of time and solve problems before they happen

  • Hands-on vendor coordination: You've booked sessions, negotiated rates, confirmed deliverables, and held vendors accountable to deadlines.

  • Comfort owning a project-level budget: Experience tracking actuals, flagging cost issues, reconciling at wrap.

  • Strong communicator: You manage people well and know how to get the best out of people across production, editorial, and external vendors.

Nice to Have

  • Experience producing post across both scripted and unscripted formats

  • Familiarity with social-first content (TikTok, YouTube, IG) as well as traditional broadcast/streaming

  • Experience negotiating with vendors, evaluating and hiring post-production talent, and managing creatives

  • Comfortable building and refining processes, not just following them

  • A hands-on post-production background, with the ability to jump in and fill resource gaps when needed

title: Driver Night Shift (1260197)
location: Cincinnati - United States, Ohio, United States
description:
The purpose of the Driver role is to ensure the safe, efficient, compliant, and timely transportation of critical life sciences shipments, including biological samples, medical kits, MedTech supplies, and other related cargo. This position is pivotal in managing the logistics of shipments from airports, laboratories, and other designated locations, ensuring that all transportation processes are conducted with the highest standards of safety and regulatory compliance. The driver is fully responsible for overseeing the proper handling, sorting, and documentation of all shipments, maintaining the integrity of the cargo, and ensuring its timely delivery. By managing operations at the airport and resolving any issues that arise, the driver plays a crucial role in the success of the logistics process, ensuring the reliability and efficiency of transportation services for life sciences products.

General Duties:

  • Cargo Handling & Transport: Safely load of biological samples, medical kits, MedTech supplies, and other life science-related shipments, ensuring that shipments are handled and delivered on time.

  • Cargo Inspection: Inspect the condition of cargo upon receipt to verify that it meets required standards.

  • Vehicle and equipment Management: Maintain vehicles in optimal working conditions, performing regular inspections, including but not limited to engine, brakes, lights, fuel level, etc.

  • Ensure cleanliness and readiness for daily operations.

  • Operate cargo vans, pickup trucks, and trucks (up to 26’) safely and professionally

  • Ensure GPS tracking, mobile phones, and security systems are fully functional prior to route start.

  • Deadline Adherence: Understand and meet all shipment deadlines, ensuring that time-sensitive deliveries are prioritized and completed, taking into consideration airlines cut-off times.

  • Documentation & Reporting: Accurately document transportation activities, including mileage logs, vehicle inspections, and any incidents that may occur during transport.

  • Maintain vehicle logbooks and immediately report mechanical or operational issues to dispatch.

  • Safety & Compliance: Comply with all TSA, airport, and transportation regulations, ensuring safety and confidentiality throughout the process. Report any accidents or issues immediately.

  • Loading & Unloading cargo: Provide support in loading and unloading shipments, especially those exceeding 50 lbs., ensuring that all packages are securely handled.

Responsibilities:

  • Full Responsibility for Airport Operations: Oversee all airport operations, from cargo retrieval and drop-off to ensuring timely shipment processing. Coordinate and manage airport tasks to ensure smooth, uninterrupted operations.

  • Driver Coordination & responsibility: Take charge of coordinating pick-up and drop-off schedules, ensuring that all stakeholders have the necessary documentation and information for smooth deliveries. Ensure that airport operations follow all procedures and service instructions according to the specific type of service or requirements.

  • Cold Chain Management: Manage the handling of temperature-controlled shipments, including dry ice shipments and gel packs, ensuring proper re-icing, packaging, and temperature control is maintained throughout the transportation process according to the SOP’s.

  • Consolidation & Labeling: Organize and oversee the preparation of shipping labels and ensure that consolidator boxes are correctly assembled. Verify documentation for outbound shipments, ensuring all details are accurate.

  • Re-Icing & Packaging Support: Provide support for temperature-sensitive shipments, including overseeing gel pack replacement and repackaging when necessary.

  • Airport Operations: Facilitate airline drop-offs and retrievals, ensuring necessary paperwork is prepared and shipment statuses are tracked in real-time. Assist in navigating airline processes to ensure timely shipment handling.

  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure that all activities align with company policies, airport regulations, and TSA guidelines. Enforce compliance with industry regulations and procedures for every operation.

  • Client & Stakeholder Communication: Communicate effectively with clients, stakeholders, and internal teams to confirm schedules, locations, and special instructions to ensure a high level of customer service.

Key Responsibilities Overview:

  • Full Ownership of Airport Operations

  • Cold Chain & Temperature-Controlled Cargo Management

  • Driver Coordination, Leadership, and Support

  • Cargo Inspection, Sorting, and Labeling

  • Compliance with Regulations & Safety Protocols

  • Vehicle and Equipment Support

Qualifications & Skills Required:

  • Must be able to operate cargo vans, small trucks (up to 26’), and pick-up trucks, as needed, to support local and regional deliveries.

  • Basic understanding of cold chain logistics, biohazard handling, and regulatory compliance for biological and medical shipments. Knowledge of temperature-sensitive shipping requirements (e.g., dry ice and gel packs) is a plus.

  • Strong organizational abilities with keen attention to detail, ensuring accurate tracking, documentation, and adherence to operational protocols.

  • Capable of maintaining efficiency and focus in fast-paced, high-pressure environments while adhering to tight deadlines.

  • Willingness to work outside regular business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as required by operational needs.

  • Proactive in recognizing shipment-related issues and effectively addressing them to ensure smooth transportation and delivery.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment where priorities and schedules may shift unexpectedly.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills for clear interactions with team members, clients, and stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with scanners, barcodes, and tracking systems is advantageous for managing logistics and shipment tracking.

  • Capable of lifting packages up to approximately 50 pounds and assisting with loading/unloading heavy shipments.

  • Ability to adjust to changing schedules and operational needs, ensuring flexibility for urgent requests or shift changes.

  • Exceptional attention to detail to ensure accuracy in all documentation, adherence to safety protocols, and compliance with transportation regulations.

  • The Ability to work in a very fast pace and high stress working environment.

  • Proactive problem-solving skills for addressing shipment-related issues.

  • Strong communication skills in English and Spanish.

  • Experience with scanners, barcodes, and tracking systems is a plus.

  • Ability to lift and handle shipments up to 50 lbs.

  • Valid driver’s license (CDL not required) with a clean driving record.

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

Work Setting

  • Primarily operates at airports or in urban and suburban areas, delivering packages and goods to residential and commercial locations.

  • Prepare shipments at the airport before dispatch.

  • Works in locations such as loading docks, cargo warehouses, and aircraft loading areas.

  • Must be able to assist with loading and unloading shipments over 50 lbs.

  • May transport cargo to and from air cargo facilities, including freight terminals and cargo ramps.

  • Occasional domestic or international travel may be required for industry events or emergency response situations.

  • This role may involve working outside standard business hours to meet client needs or handling urgent issues.

title: Senior GRC Analyst (Security Assurance)
description:
GRC at TRACTIAN

The Engineering team at Tractian is at the forefront of developing cutting-edge infrastructure, technologies, and products to harness the power of IoT data. Our team of talented Engineers collaborates to build robust systems, innovative solutions, and scalable platforms that drive Tractian's success. We are instrumental in shaping the company's decision-making process, optimizing operational efficiency, and delivering exceptional experiences to our consumers.

What you'll do

As a GRC Analyst, you will be responsible for developing and implementing robust governance, risk management, and compliance (GRC) practices within our technology-driven organization. You will play a key role in establishing frameworks and processes that ensure the security, integrity, and regulatory compliance of our technology systems. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to assess risks, implement controls, and drive continuous improvement of our GRC program.

Key Responsibilities
  • Support the continuous maintenance and improvement of the organization's Information Security Management System (ISMS), ensuring alignment with ISO 27001/27002, SOC 2, and applicable NIST frameworks.
  • Perform compliance assessments, control reviews, and gap analyses, driving remediation plans and tracking corrective actions through completion.
  • Develop, review, and maintain information security policies, standards, procedures, and governance documentation, while monitoring the effectiveness and adoption of security controls across the organization.
  • Support internal and external audits by coordinating evidence collection, maintaining audit documentation, responding to auditor requests, and ensuring continuous audit readiness.
  • Support the implementation and continuous improvement of secure development practices by reviewing processes, advising Engineering and Product teams, and promoting Privacy by Design and Privacy by Default principles.
  • Support Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) activities, including vendor security assessments, risk reviews, remediation tracking, and continuous improvement of third-party governance processes, aligned with the organization's Risk Management Program.
  • Maintain controls, evidence, remediation plans, and compliance records within the organization's GRC platform, ensuring information remains accurate, current, and audit-ready.
  • Support customer security and compliance due diligence activities, including security questionnaires (SIG, CAIQ, RFPs, etc.), in collaboration with the GRC team and subject matter experts.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Product, Security, and business teams to integrate governance, risk, and compliance practices into business and technology initiatives.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on a variety of Security GRC initiatives, contributing to governance, risk, compliance, and assurance programs in support of shared organizational goals.

Requirements
  • Background in Information Technology, Information Security, Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC), Internal Audit, Compliance, or Quality Management.
  • Experience supporting Information Security Management Systems (ISMS) and assessing compliance with security frameworks and standards, including ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27002, SOC 2, and NIST.
  • Knowledge of data protection best practices and compliance requirements under the LGPD and GDPR.
  • Experience performing compliance assessments, internal audits, control reviews, gap analyses, and remediation tracking.
  • Experience developing and maintaining information security policies, standards, procedures, and governance documentation.
  • Experience with Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), including vendor security assessments and remediation follow-up.
  • Hands-on experience implementing, monitoring, and validating security and compliance controls.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering, IT, Security, Procurement, Legal, and business teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

Nice to Have
  • Experience with compliance automation and GRC platforms (e.g., Vanta, Drata, etc.).
  • Experience working with multiple security frameworks and regulatory environments.
  • Experience using task and project management platforms (e.g., Jira, Linear, Monday, etc.) to manage remediation plans and compliance initiatives.
  • Market-recognized security certifications.
  • Experience leveraging automation and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to improve GRC processes, evidence collection, reporting, and compliance operations.

Soft Skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Proactive, analytical, and solution-oriented.
  • Highly organized, with strong attention to documentation and audit evidence.
  • Team-oriented mindset (one person’s problem is everyone’s problem).
  • Comfortable working in dynamic environments and navigating ambiguity.
  • Ability to independently drive assigned initiatives and deliver high-quality results.
  • Continuous improvement mindset focused on strengthening organizational resilience.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Education and courses stipend
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years
  • R$1.035/month for meals allowance
  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation
  • Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.
  • Wellhub and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities

title: Senior Associate, Operational Mapping Specialist
description:
LA28 does not provide relocation assistance for any positions. If you are based outside the Los Angeles area, we still welcome your application — we value talent from all geographic backgrounds and want to hear from you if you are able to work on-site in LA.

LA28 is the independent, non-profit, privately funded organizing committee for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games. We are on a singular mission to create an Olympic and Paralympic Games that celebrate all that this city and country have to offer, delivering an unparalleled experience for athletes, fans, partners and our community.

The 2028 Games mark the return of the Summer Games to the U.S. for the first time in 32 years and Los Angeles’ third time hosting an Olympic Games and first time welcoming the Paralympic Games. This presents the unique and exciting opportunity to celebrate our legacy with the Games and push the Olympic and Paralympic Movements forward, writing a new chapter of Games history in Los Angeles.

Putting on an Olympic and Paralympic Games is a team sport. To build a Games unlike any the world has seen before, we need the best team in place–a team full of perspectives, experiences and expertise. We are guided by the following set of values and behaviors–optimism, integrity, excellence, inclusion, co-creation and boldness–and look forward to hearing about how your past experiences align with them.

Operational Mapping Specialist

The Event Management team is responsible for leading the integrated event operational planning at the venue level for all competition and some major non-competition venues. The group is also responsible for managing and coordinating the negotiation of venue agreements, the collation and organization of venue-related documentation and data, and the maintenance of strong working relationships with all venue partners. At Games Time, the Event Management team leads and manages the event teams at venues, event delivery, venue communication, and venue issue resolution.

The Senior Associate, Operational Mapping is a specialized, technical, and highly collaborative role within the EVM team. This position serves as the critical bridge between complex technical layouts (developed in Autodesk Revit) and operational planning, converting architectural data and stakeholder concepts into clean, intuitive, and highly functional 2D operational maps. Acting as the department's visual translator, the Senior Associate establishes mapping standards, coordinates master mapping timelines, and guides cross-functional teams to ensure all venue operations are visually documented with precision, clarity, and consistency.

This position will report to the Senior Manager, Central Planning.

Key Responsibilities

Workflow Development & Spatial Visualization

  • Develop and maintain efficient workflows to take physical temporary overlays and venue architectural plans built in Autodesk Revit and export them into formats suitable for operational planning.
  • Build KMZ/KML file structures on top of Revit outputs to create interactive, multi-layered digital maps depicting operational components.
  • Create high-quality, printed, and digital 2D maps depicting operational requirements such as pedestrian and vehicle flows, equipment placement, team deployment, and egress paths, accessible routes, and other operational drawings.

SME Consultation & Visual Translation

  • Serve as the central visual translator for the EVM department.
  • Interview Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and venue teams to extract operational requirements.
  • Take complex, unstructured, or verbal explanations from SMEs and accurately translate them into simplified visual tools that depict the core concepts.
  • Produce initial drafts of operational plans, rapidly iterating based on stakeholder feedback and technical specifications.

Version Control & Quality Assurance

  • Design, implement, and oversee rigorous version control and file-naming standards for all operational maps.
  • Establish formal sign-off and approval procedures with venue and departmental stakeholders to ensure all active plans represent the most up-to-date and authorized layouts.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration & Project Management

  • Train and guide Associates and coordinators across other departments on mapping workflows, best practices, and visualization standards.
  • Develop and manage the mapping development phases over a two-year timeline, coordinating multiple departmental plans into a single, holistic master project plan.
  • Act as the project manager for all EVM mapping deliverables, tracking milestones, managing dependencies, and reporting progress to PMO leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of progressive experience in operational mapping, event spatial planning, GIS, architectural visualization, CAD drafting, urban planning, scenic design, or event venue operations.
  • Technical Spatial Skills: Proficient in navigating, isolating views, and exporting clean base files from Autodesk Revit and AutoCAD. Expert in building custom, layered KMZ/KML files and overlays.
  • Version Control & QA: Solid understanding of rigid version control, file-naming protocols, and master-file management in a fast-paced environment.
  • Project Management: Experience scheduling and coordinating mapping production phases, tracking milestones, and managing multi-departmental dependencies over a multi-year horizon.
  • Collaborative and Flexible Approach: Ability to roll with the transitional nature of the organization as it grows, adapting quickly to changing priorities.
  • Visual Passion: An instinctive understanding of how to depict complex 3D spaces using 2D tools and maps, with a passion for clean visual communications.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Overlay & Temporary Infrastructure Planning: Experience working on major multi-sport events, festivals, or exhibitions where temporary structures (tents, grandstands, fencing, cabins) are integrated into existing spaces.
  • Visual Graphic Design: Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (e.g. Illustrator or InDesign) to transform raw CAD/Revit exports into highly polished, color-coded, and intuitive 2D maps.

Physical Expectations

  • The position is in Los Angeles with in-person attendance required.
  • The majority of work will be conducted in an office setting, requiring extended periods of time using computers, phones, and other office equipment

Expectations

  • Collaborative and flexible approach – Ability to roll with the transitional nature of the organization as it grows, adapting quickly to changing priorities and requirements
  • A committed team player with problem-solving skills, comfortable working cross-functionally with diverse stakeholder groups both internally and externally
  • Confident self-starter – Takes initiative to identify challenges, gathering inputs from key stakeholders, takes action, and resolves challenges proactively
  • Excitement for the role and opportunity to help shape the future of Los Angeles and the Olympic and Paralympic Movement

Education / Training / Certifications

  • Post-secondary technical certificate or professional diploma in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Urban Planning, Architecture, Graphic Design, Sport Management, or a related field.
  • Professional training or certifications in Autodesk AutoCAD/Revit, ESRI ArcGIS/QGIS, or Adobe Creative Suite is highly desirable.
  • Demonstration of equivalent work experience

Compensation

The annual base salary range for this position $73,000-$98,000. The pay scale provided is the range that LA28 reasonably expects to pay as starting base compensation for this role. title: Forsikringsmæglere søges til hele landet
description:
Vi beder hverken om CV eller ansøgning til denne rolle - du skal blot dele din LinkedIn profil og svare et enkelt spørgsmål.

Erfarne branchefolk og succesfulde iværksættere har bygget et setup, der giver dig som forsikringsmægler usædvanligt gode rammer. Norlix er en smartere tilgang til forsikrings- og pensionsrådgivning.

Du er allerede erhvervsassurandør eller forsikringsmægler og har minimum en IDD 2-certificering. Du er dygtig og ved godt selv, hvorfor du lykkes. Det er ikke smarte salgstricks eller rundsave på albuerne. Det er din grundige behovsafdækning, din ærlige interesse for kundens forretning, og så er det din evne til at opbygge gode relationer.

Og måske sidder du med en fornemmelse af, at for meget af din tid går med mødebooking, processer, policer og systemer, der tager fokus fra det, du faktisk er bedst til og det, der giver dig mest energi.

Norlix har lavet et job til dig

Norlix er en nyligt lanceret insurtech-virksomhed, stiftet af erfarne erhvervsfolk og støttet af stærke investorer fra det danske startup- og tech-miljø, bl.a. Flatpay. Tjek teamet ud her.

Her står kold kanvas ikke på din to-do. Det gør gennemtrawling af policer heller ikke.

Norlix fjerner manuel friktion, så du som mægler kan fokusere din tid med kunden. I stedet for tunge processer og gammeldags rådgivning, bruger I AI og smarte integrationer til at hente, analysere og forstå virksomhedsdata. På den måde sikrer I, at kunderne altid er korrekt dækket – til den bedste pris.

Og Norlix' mæglere har fyldte kalendere fra starten, det sørger deres egne og dygtige mødebookere for.

Du får så mange møder, som du vil have - med forudgående undersøgelsesfuldmagt indhentet og policer analyseret af din AI assistent, så du kan fokusere på kunden og på at lukke salget. Det afspejler sig i din løn.

Du er stjerneangriberen

Vi forestiller os, at du trives bedst her på holdet, hvis du:

  • er en vedvarende performer

  • kan lide det selvstændige arbejde - men også værdsætter dit heppekor

  • kan lide tempo frem for tunge rutiner

  • har lyst til at være en del af en tech-drevet scaleup

Du bliver funktionæransat og kan bo hvor som helst, for Norlix øger lige nu deres tilstedeværelse i hele landet.

Forstår du, hvor de vil hen? Og vil du med? Så vil vi rigtig gerne høre fra dig.

Job Summary

As a Revenue Cycle Intelligence Associate, you will lead customer initiatives and support the development and delivery of technology-enabled service offerings. You’ll work closely with customers to leverage Kodiak’s analytics platform and your experience as a revenue cycle operator to drive operational improvements and financial performance across the revenue cycle. This role requires a blend of healthcare revenue cycle expertise, analytical acumen, and customer-facing experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with Engagement Managers with customer engagements focused on revenue cycle transformation and performance improvement.
  • Analyze complex healthcare data sets to identify trends, root causes, and actionable insights.
  • Develop and present detailed reports, dashboards, and visualizations using BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement data-driven solutions.
  • Translate business needs into technical requirements and ensure successful delivery solution.
  • Provide subject matter expertise on revenue cycle operations, KPIs, and best practices.
  • Contribute to knowledge sharing across the organization by developing documentation and reusable tools that support team success.
  • Support product development by identifying opportunities for innovation and automation.
  • Participate in customer meetings, presentations, and strategic planning sessions.
  • Travel occasionally to customer sites as needed (estimated <20%).
  • Foster an environment of ownership of project and customer success

Required Qualifications

A strong candidate will possess:

Experience:

  • Minimum 2+ years of progressive experience in healthcare revenue cycle operations, or consulting.
  • Prior experience in a professional services or consulting environment is strongly preferred.
  • Experience working with or for RCM vendors, health systems, or payers is highly valued.

Domain Knowledge:

  • Deep understanding of revenue cycle KPIs, workflows, and operational levers (e.g., denials, A/R, cash collections, charge capture).
  • Ability to interpret and communicate complex financial and operational data to non-technical stakeholders.

Technical Skills:

  • Proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, and Excel.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
  • Familiarity with EHR/EMR systems (e.g., Epic, Cerner) and healthcare data standards (e.g., HL7, FHIR) is a plus.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Health Informatics, or a related field.

Certifications (Preferred):

  • PMP, RHIA, CRCR, HFMA certifications, or other relevant credentials.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including experience crafting executive-level presentations.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

High attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work.

title: Court Operations Associate - Scott County District Court - Minor Criminal/Juvenile/CHIPS/Family
description:
The First Judicial District is seeking qualified applicants for a customer-focused and team-oriented Court Operations Associate to join the Minor Criminal/Juvenile/CHIPS/Family Division of the Scott County Court Administration team at the Scott County Justice Center in Shakopee, MN.

This Court Operations Associate position is fast paced, highly detail-orientated position with a variety of responsibilities. Primary responsibilities include advanced case processing in an electronic environment, extensive work in the courtroom, including live case updating while court is in session, and providing exceptional customer service on the phone and in person. This position will work directly with the public, juries, judges and justice partners. Duties require the application of independent judgment and the interpretation of established laws, policies, procedures, regulations based on training and knowledge gained through experience on the job.

The primary work location is in the Minor Criminal/Juvenile/CHIPS/Family Division of the Scott County Justice Center, 200 Fourth Avenue West, Shakopee, MN 55379. In-person or hybrid options are available. Standard hours of work are Monday - Friday, 8:00 AM - 4:30 PM.

The Minnesota Judicial Branch is pleased to offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and optional benefits and paid vacation, sick leave and paid holidays.

What You Will Do

The following are examples of major job duties expected of this position:

  • Performs the full range of court operations work within the Criminal, Traffic, Juvenile, CHIPS, and Family Division, using electronic case processing system and related applications and equipment. Performs in-court updating including calling cases, taking minutes, processing documents filed and distributed in the courtroom, and recording required data regarding parties, documents, flags, comments, and events in electronic case management and other relevant systems in the courtroom.
  • Initiates case records using electronic means or paper documents; records required data regarding parties, documents, flags, comments, events, and dispositions in case processing system and other relevant systems; notifies relevant individuals about missing information, documents, or non-compliant legal forms.
  • Schedules and maintains court calendars; assigns cases to regularly scheduled calendars; updates, reschedules, and reassigns cases as necessary and notifies parties and attorneys.
  • Provides assistance to attorneys, parties, self-represented litigants, judges, and the public by responding to a variety of questions in-person, over the phone, by mail, and/or electronically; provides forms, documents, and court procedure information; assists public in filling out various applications and forms; checks people in for court; refers new or complex questions to higher level staff.
  • Attends and participates in division/team meetings and trainings; maintains knowledge of court policies, process, and procedures.
  • Utilizes applicable technology (i.e., operating and information systems and/or programs) and office equipment to perform and complete work assignments.


What You Must Have

The Minnesota Judicial Branch recognizes the diverse set of skills, strengths, and attributes that an individual may bring into a role. If you have any combination of the experience, training, and education required for this position, apply today!

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent

Aircraft painter applies pre-mixed and blended paint or coating to interior and exterior of assembled aircrafts or parts. Prepares surfaces for painting and protects painted surfaces from erosion. Work closely with aircraft engineers to ensure that their work meets all safety standards.

  • Applying protective coatings to aircraft external surfaces such as wings, fuselages, or tails

  • Solid understanding of painting techniques, materials, and equipment

title: Senior Sales Engineer, Global
description:
About Us:

Datacor is the leading provider of software solutions, including ERP, CRM, Asset Tracking, Simulation and Formulation, to the process manufacturing space. We are on a mission to better equip the industry with software solutions and move it forward by building thoughtful, intuitive products that solve our customers’ most difficult problems.

We are passionate about serving our customers and helping them use data as a competitive advantage. Our customers make products that extend and sustain lives by sanitizing, fertilizing, beautifying, cleaning, and recycling the world we live in. We at Datacor help our customers make those products you use every day more safely, cost effectively and more efficiently through our technology platforms and applications.

About The Role:

Datacor is growing, and so is the demand on our Solution Engineering team. This is a newly created role built to scale our pre-sales capacity across our expanding international footprint. You will be our dedicated technical presence outside the Americas, based in Europe or the Middle East and covering European, Middle Eastern, African, and APAC markets.

Your primary focus will be Datacor Flow Simulation, our core pipe flow and fluid simulation platform. You will own Flow Simulation pre-sales from day one, delivering discovery, demonstrations, and technical support across the full sales cycle, partnering with Account Executives across Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and APAC. Our broader portfolio also includes GoldSim and CHEMCAD. Familiarity with those products is a plus and will create cross-sell opportunities over time, but it is not a requirement for this role.

You will ramp under the mentorship of our senior Solution Engineer with a structured onboarding plan. Candidates with a pipe flow, fluid dynamics, or process engineering background will get up to speed quickly.

What You Will Do:

Pre-Sales Coverage:

  • Partner with Account Executives across Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and APAC to run discovery calls, deliver product demonstrations, and handle technical questions throughout the sales cycle
  • Deliver compelling Flow Simulation demonstrations tailored to prospect pain points, adapting messaging for industries including chemical processing, specialty manufacturing, oil and gas, mining, and utilities
  • Build and maintain Flow Simulation demonstration environments, use cases, and proof-of-concept scenarios relevant to active verticals and geographies
  • Support RFP and RFI responses and technical proposals in collaboration with the sales team

Partner and Channel Enablement:

  • Support regional and global technical partners with Flow Simulation training, enablement sessions, and joint demonstrations
  • Develop partner-facing materials including lunch and learns, webinars, and demo scripts
  • Act as a technical resource for channel partners engaging customers in any territory

Marketing and Events

  • Represent Datacor at trade shows and industry conferences relevant to the portfolio, including process industries, mining, oil and gas, and utilities
  • Contribute to webinars, product demos for marketing campaigns, and demand generation content
  • Surface case study opportunities to Marketing based on themes that come up in demos and discovery
  • Deliver live product presentations at events alongside regional Account Executives
  • Partner with Account Executives on customer-facing lunch and learns and product sessions to engage existing accounts and surface expansion opportunities

Collaboration and Product Feedback

  • Build deep Flow Simulation product fluency during a structured ramp period supported by our senior Solution Engineer
  • Develop working familiarity with GoldSim and CHEMCAD over time to support cross-sell opportunities alongside the broader team
  • Provide feedback to Product on feature gaps, competitive observations, and customer requests from across global markets
  • Collaborate with Marketing on vertical-specific messaging and campaign content

Required:

  • 3 to 5 years in a Solution Engineering, Sales Engineering, or technical pre-sales role at an engineering software, simulation, or process technology company
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver software demonstrations to both technical and business audiences, including engineers, plant managers, and project teams
  • Strong discovery skills, with the ability to uncover pain, map it to value, and confidently handle technical objections
  • Degree in mechanical engineering, with hands-on piping experience such as piping system design, hydraulic analysis, or plant and pipeline engineering
  • Familiarity with pipe flow simulation and fluid dynamics software
  • Comfortable operating independently and managing multiple concurrent engagements across different countries, cultures, and time zones
  • Willingness to travel upward of 60% across European, Middle Eastern, African, and APAC markets
  • Based in Europe or the Middle East with the right to work in that location

Strongly Preferred:

  • Experience with Datacor Flow Simulation (formerly AFT) products: Fathom, Arrow, Impulse, and xStream
  • Additional background in chemical or process engineering alongside the mechanical discipline
  • Experience selling into or working within mining, oil and gas, utilities, or specialty chemical verticals
  • Familiarity with GoldSim or CHEMCAD
  • Prior experience working with channel or reseller partners
  • German or French language skills. Arabic is also valuable for Middle East coverage
  • Proficiency with CRM tools such as Salesforce or HubSpot, and with webinar and demo platforms

Location and Travel:

This role is remote and must be based in Europe or the Middle East. This is an international role and does not cover the Americas.

Travel is a core part of the job and will run upward of 60%. Expect regular customer visits, trade shows, partner events, and time on site with prospects across the region. Candidates should also be comfortable with schedule flexibility to accommodate calls across multiple time zones.

EOE Statement:

Datacor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis or race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Use of AI During Interviews:

At Datacor, we value thoughtful problem-solving and authentic perspectives. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation process, we ask that candidates do not use generative AI tools or outside assistance during live interviews unless explicitly stated otherwise. We're interested in hearing your experience, your approach, and how you think through challenges.

title: Program Manager, Pharmacy Operations (Contract to Perm)
description:
Who We Are

Evergreen Nephrology partners with nephrologists to transform kidney care through a value-based, person-centered, holistic, and comprehensive approach to kidney care. We believe patients living with kidney disease deserve the best care. We are committed to improving patient outcomes and improving quality of life by delaying disease progression, shifting care to the home, and accelerating kidney transplants.

We help nephrologists focus on the right patients at the right time across the full care spectrum. We do this by providing them with the best-in-class interdisciplinary clinical resources, analytical insight and tools, and services to patients. We listen to the needs of our patients, our employees, and our client partners, continually working to push beyond the status quo in which the care system manages patients today.

Who You Are

You are devoted, compassionate, and enjoy being on the front lines of healthcare, changing the lives of patients by supporting them and the team by focusing on customers. You’re excited about being part of a team that is building a healthcare delivery model that ensures the highest possible quality of life and best outcomes for those in our care. You believe people living with kidney disease deserve the best person-centered, holistic, comprehensive care and want to influence the healthcare system to drive towards that. You thrive in innovative and evolving environments with high rates of change.

Your Role

As the Program Manager, Pharmacy Operations with Evergreen Nephrology, you will lead the implementation, growth, and ongoing operational success of Evergreen's pharmacy program. This is a 6-month contract with the opportunity to convert to full-time employment. This program connects patients with a specialized pharmacy partner that provides pre-sorted, multi-dose medication packaging, home delivery, proactive refill management, and ongoing pharmacist support designed to improve medication adherence and simplify complex medication regimens for patients living with chronic kidney disease and other chronic conditions.

In this role, you will provide leadership and oversight for a team of Pharmacy Care Coordinators responsible for patient outreach, enrollment, consent capture, documentation, and pharmacy workflow execution. You will oversee day-to-day program operations, establish standardized processes, monitor performance metrics, and ensure consistent execution across participating practices and markets.

You will partner closely with provider practices, pharmacy partners, internal operational teams, and clinical stakeholders to support successful implementation, drive enrollment growth, remove operational barriers, and continuously improve the patient and provider experience. This role requires a balance of strategic thinking and hands-on operational leadership, with accountability for program performance, team development, implementation success, and operational excellence.

While this position is fully remote, you must be able to work 8:30am – 5pm in the central or eastern time zone. This position will also require occasional travel to practice sites.

Role Responsibilities

Some responsibilities may vary based on specific patient programs, but this role's primary duties include the following:

  • Oversee day-to-day operations of Evergreen's pharmacy program, ensuring consistent execution of enrollment, outreach, documentation, and pharmacy workflow processes.
  • Lead, develop, and support a team of Pharmacy Care Coordinators through onboarding, training, coaching, performance management, and ongoing professional development.
  • Establish and maintain operational workflows, standard operating procedures, training materials, scripts, and job aids that support consistent program execution and scalability.
  • Monitor program performance against established enrollment, productivity, quality, and operational metrics; identify trends and implement improvement plans when needed.
  • Develop and maintain program dashboards, reports, and performance summaries for operational and leadership stakeholders.
  • Lead implementation activities for new provider practices, markets, and pharmacy program expansions, ensuring operational readiness and successful launch execution.
  • Partner with provider practices, pharmacy partners, and internal Evergreen stakeholders to identify operational barriers, resolve issues, and improve program performance.
  • Serve as the primary operational escalation point for complex patient, practice, provider, workflow, or pharmacy-related concerns.
  • Conduct routine quality reviews, call audits, workflow assessments, and documentation reviews to ensure adherence to program standards, approved workflows, and compliance requirements.
  • Analyze enrollment performance, workflow effectiveness, and operational outcomes to identify opportunities for process improvement and program optimization.
  • Collaborate with pharmacy partners and internal operational teams to support effective communication, issue resolution, and alignment on program objectives.
  • Support staffing planning, workforce allocation, and resource management to ensure appropriate program coverage and operational performance.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and exceptional service for patients, provider partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Uphold patient privacy and confidentiality standards in accordance with HIPAA and organizational policies.
  • Other duties consistent with this role, as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Public Health, Nursing, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in healthcare operations, pharmacy operations, patient engagement, patient enrollment, care management support programs, population health, or a related healthcare environment.
  • 2+ years of leadership experience managing teams, programs, projects, or operational initiatives.
  • Experience leading high-volume patient outreach, enrollment, customer engagement, or operational workflow teams.
  • Demonstrated experience developing, monitoring, and improving operational performance metrics and key performance indicators.
  • Experience onboarding, coaching, developing, and evaluating team members.
  • Experience working within electronic health record (EHR/EMR) systems and healthcare operational workflows.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable operational improvements.
  • Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Execution-focused and hands-on, with the ability to effectively balance strategic priorities and day-to-day operational responsibilities.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA and healthcare privacy requirements.
  • Intermediate skills with MS Office Suite of products including Outlook and Teams
  • Able to work effectively in a primarily remote environment:
    • Home internet must support a minimum download speed of 25 Mbps and upload speed of 10 Mbps. Cable, Fiber, or DSL connections hardwired to the internet device are recommended
    • Evergreen will provide remote employees with telephony applications and equipment to meet the business requirements for their role
    • Employees must work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing healthcare enrollment programs, patient engagement initiatives, population health programs, or pharmacy-related services.
  • Experience leading implementations, practice launches, operational transformations, or new program deployments.
  • Experience supporting medication adherence, pharmacy operations, prescription management workflows, or value-based care programs.
  • Experience developing dashboards, performance reporting, and operational analytics.
  • Experience working with nephrology, chronic kidney disease, ESRD, or other complex chronic disease populations.
  • Experience managing external vendors, strategic partners, or healthcare service providers.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish.

Compensation

The pay range for this role is $115,000-$120,000 annually. Exact pay is determined based on experience, education, demand for the role, and other role-specific factors.

This role is also eligible for an annual bonus.

Benefits

Evergreen Nephrology’s total rewards program is designed to support you in and outside of work. You can expect:

  • Paid time off starting at 4 weeks for full-time employees
  • 12 paid holidays per year
  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance, including an HSA with employer match
  • Reimbursement for continuing medical education for eligible roles
  • A 401(k) program where Evergreen matches up to 4% of contributions after six months of tenure
  • Paid parental leave
  • A robust training and development program that starts with onboarding and continues throughout your career with Evergreen Nephrology

Evergreen Nephrology is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition or any other protected category under local, state or federal laws.

If you are an applicant with a disability who requires reasonable accommodation for any part of the hiring process, please contact us for assistance at recruiting@evergreennephrology.com.

title: Head of Investor Relations
description:
Investor Relations at Private Equity Insights

This role offers you the opportunity to expand and nurture our community of key VIP groups such as institutional investors (LPs) and other key stakeholders in the Private Equity Industry.
Do you want to take part in defining the future of Private Equity? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about people and building relationships? If so, you might be our next member of the investor relations team.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 500k followers on LinkedIn organising a series of 12 global private equity events every year with 2,000+ GPs, 1,000+ LPs among the attendees.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media () which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

You get the unique opportunity to take ownership of one of our key business areas. You’ll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never-ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • The opportunity of having a real impact - You’ll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.
  • Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company.
  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.

  • Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.

Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:

  • Identify, maintain and develop long-standing and fruitful relationships with institutional investors who can benefit from the targeted offering of our product and network
  • Accommodate the investment strategy of the LP by facilitating 1:1 meetings with relevant fund managers

  • Take ownership of everything they do, are proactive and follow through on commitments;
  • Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations;
  • Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;
  • Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.

Start date

Flexible

The role is onsite, Monday to Friday, based in our offices at Sloane Square. It is essential we work at a fast pace and collaborate in person to create market-leading, unmatched events throughout the calendar year. It will be great to have you as part of our team.

  • Add to a team culture of diversity, opportunity, inclusion, and respect

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Proficiency in Python or another object-oriented language (Java, C++) with a proven track record of high-quality, successful delivery
  • Hands-on experience building and operating distributed systems with Apache Kafka, including partitions and consumer groups, exactly-once semantics, and schema management
  • Strong experience with cloud infrastructure on AWS and infrastructure-as-code tooling (e.g., ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, S3, KMS, IAM, CloudWatch; Terraform or CloudFormation)
  • Strong grasp of event-driven and microservices architecture, REST APIs, and asynchronous messaging patterns
  • Proven experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and safe deployment strategies such as blue/green or canary releases
  • Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices
  • Solid reliability and observability fundamentals, including retries, idempotency, timeouts, and logs/metrics/tracing
  • Experience leading projects or teams, setting technical direction, and delivering complex production systems
  • Experience working in Agile or Scrum delivery environments
  • Hands-on experience with observability tooling such as Datadog or Grafana

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Experience applying observability practices — metrics, logs, and tracing — and site reliability engineering principles for production systems

title: Concession Specialist

title: Intermediate & Senior Designer/Concept Artist (On-Site)
description:

Known for our commitment to quality, efficiency, and timely deliveries, ICON has partnered with distributors, broadcasters, and leading streaming platforms worldwide to create and produce noteworthy, impactful projects.

Intermediate Designer / Concept Artist

title: Defence Compliance Advisor
description:
The Defence Compliance Advisor plays a critical role in ensuring Fleetway’s ability to operate effectively within complex, highly regulated defence environments. This position serves as a subject matter expert on regulatory, security, and contractual compliance requirements, supporting the organization from early bid stages through to program execution.

Acting as a key bridge between external obligations and internal operations, the Advisor interprets customer and regulatory requirements (including ITAR, Controlled Goods, and international security frameworks) and translates them into practical, scalable processes. You will proactively assess Fleetway’s readiness, identify risks and gaps, and partner across the business to implement strong, sustainable compliance controls.

This role is both strategic and hands-on—enabling informed business decisions, strengthening governance, and ensuring the organization is positioned to meet evolving compliance demands in the defence sector.

Assess Contract and Bid Compliance Requirements

  • Review and interpret regulatory, security, and contractual requirements in bids, proposals, and awarded contracts
  • Analyze obligations related to ITAR/EAR, Controlled Goods Program (CGP), UK security controls, and other jurisdictional frameworks
  • Provide clear guidance to business development and contracts teams on compliance feasibility, risks, and implementation considerations

Evaluate Internal Processes and Controls

  • Conduct assessments of current processes, procedures, and controls against defence compliance requirements
  • Identify gaps, inefficiencies, or areas of potential risk
  • Provide recommendations to strengthen internal controls and ensure audit readiness

Maintain Compliance Gap Analysis and Risk Roadmap

  • Develop and maintain a structured compliance framework aligned with regulatory obligations
  • Perform gap analyses and risk assessments across programs and functions
  • Establish and track prioritized mitigation actions and continuous improvement initiatives

Develop and Improve Compliance Processes

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Programs, Engineering, IT, HR) to design and implement compliant processes
  • Support the rollout of new controls, tools, and procedures to enhance compliance maturity
  • Drive continuous improvement and standardization of compliance practices across the organization

Monitor Regulatory Environment and Advise the Business

  • Stay current on changes to defence, security, and export control regulations
  • Assess the impact of regulatory changes on Fleetway’s operations and program delivery
  • Provide timely, practical advice to leadership and project teams to support decision-making
  • College diploma in Engineering, Business, Law, Security, or a related field
  • 8+ years of experience in defence, aerospace, shipbuilding, or another regulated industry
  • Strong understanding of export controls (ITAR/EAR), Controlled Goods Program, or similar frameworks
  • Experience interpreting contract requirements and translating them into operational processes
  • Background in security compliance and working within customer-driven regulatory environments
  • Familiarity with CGP registration (preferred)
  • ITAR/export compliance training (an asset)

title: Surgical Tech Labor and Delivery PRN NIGHTS
description:
Job Summary

The Surgical Technician – Certified works collaboratively with the surgical team to facilitate safe, effective, and high-quality patient care in the operating room. This role prepares and maintains the sterile field, anticipates surgical team needs, and ensures proper handling of surgical instruments and supplies. The Surgical Technician – Certified also supports OR efficiency through equipment readiness, inventory management, and adherence to infection prevention protocols.

Essential Functions
  • Prepares the operating room by ensuring surgical instruments, equipment, and supplies are properly set up and available based on the procedure and physician preference card.
  • Maintains a sterile field throughout the surgical procedure, applying principles of Universal Precautions, asepsis, and sterile technique.
  • Anticipates the needs of the surgeon, passing instruments and supplies accurately and efficiently during surgical procedures.
  • Handles surgical instruments and equipment according to manufacturer instructions and hospital policy, including inspection, point-of-use cleaning, and sterilization.
  • Performs and documents sponge, needle, and instrument counts in collaboration with the circulating nurse to support patient safety.
  • Assists with patient positioning, draping, and transfer under the direction of the RN to ensure patient safety and procedural readiness.
  • Supports ongoing maintenance and accuracy of physician preference cards and procedural documentation.
  • Restocks supplies, cleans and returns equipment to designated storage areas, and prepares rooms for subsequent cases to ensure OR efficiency.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.
Qualifications
  • Technical School graduate of Surgical Technology or Practical Nursing program required or
  • Associate Degree in Surgical Technology or Applied Sciences required
  • 0-2 years of operating room surgical technician experience required
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • Expertise in surgical techniques, instrumentation, and sterile processing.
  • Ability to anticipate the needs of the surgical team and respond quickly during procedures.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills to maintain efficient workflow.
  • Knowledge of regulatory and accreditation standards, including safety and infection control protocols.
  • Effective communication and teamwork skills to collaborate with the perioperative team.
  • Commitment to patient safety and high-quality care.
Licenses and Certifications
  • CST - Certified Surgical Technologist required
  • BLS - Basic Life Support required

title: Regional Communications Lead
description:
ABOUT ECHO:
ECHO is a global Christian agricultural networking, training, and resourcing organization. Our mission is to strengthen the capacity of a diverse global network to defeat hunger and improve lives through sustainable food and agroecosystem strategies. ECHO has a significant network of over 20,000 individuals and organizations built over 45 years working in more than 190 countries. These partners serve as the primary multiplier for ECHO tested options, strategies, and research.

WHY JOIN ECHO
At ECHO, you will join a global Christian network committed to defeating hunger and restoring hope through sustainable agriculture. Our team is mission-driven, collaborative, and deeply committed to equipping leaders around the world with practical tools that create lasting impact. If you are passionate about faith-integrated service and sustainable solutions, you will find meaningful purpose in this role.

SUMMARY:
The Regional Communications Lead has strategic responsibility for strengthening communications across ECHO’s Central America and Caribbean Regional Impact Center (CAC RIC), enhancing regional visibility, engagement with key audiences—including donors, partners, staff, and network members—and advancing impact storytelling. This role translates program data, learning, and field experiences into compelling, evidence-based stories aligned with ECHO’s mission, faith, and values.

The Regional Communications Lead provides strategic communications leadership for ECHO’s Central America and Caribbean Regional Impact Center (CAC RIC), strengthening regional visibility, engagement, and storytelling among key audiences including donors, partners, staff, and network members. This role translates program data, learning, and field experiences into compelling, evidence-based impact stories aligned with ECHO’s mission, faith, and values.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
  1. Strategic Communications and Messaging
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve the Regional Communications Plan to increase CAC RIC’s visibility in Central America and the Caribbean and position its strategic messages and priorities within the network, working closely with the Regional Director and aligned with ECHO’s global communications strategy.
  • In collaboration with the Regional Director and CAC RIC team, develop and communicate high-impact stories using data, learning, and experiences from network members across the CAC region.
  • Develop internal and external communication materials, including reports, donor updates, presentations, training resources, and field stories, ensuring clear, faith-aligned, technically accurate, and audience-specific messaging.
  • Lead and support the continued development of the CAC RIC’s presence on ECHOcommunity and other digital knowledge-sharing platforms.
  • In close coordination with ECHO Global Communications, ensure that regional messaging aligns with global frameworks, brand standards, and storytelling priorities.
  • Support the continual development of the CAC RIC’s presence on ECHOcommunity.org.
  1. Data-Driven Storytelling and Learning Integration
  • Coordinate with ECHO’s MEAL and global communications teams to visualize, interpret, and communicate key regional data and evaluation findings in accessible and engaging formats for various audiences.
  • Translate monitoring, evaluation, accountability, and learning (MEAL) data into donor-centered narratives and communication products that highlight results, impact, and transformation.
  • Identify compelling stories within the CAC regional network and develop them into multiple formats (case studies, reports, videos, newsletters) reflecting both scientific and spiritual impact.
  • Stay current with relevant trends, global observance days, and narrative opportunities to ensure CAC content remains dynamic and relevant.
  • Conduct periodic audience research and communication assessments to strengthen the effectiveness and relevance of regional communication strategies across multiple languages and audiences.
  • Train staff and partners to capture stories, photographs, videos, and basic impact data to support learning, communications, and donor engagement.
  1. Content & Storytelling
  • Support the development of educational materials, technical resources, and regional publications in coordination with the Regional Director and Agronomist.
  • Lead the development and distribution of a quarterly regional newsletter highlighting CAC activities, network learning, innovations, and impact stories.
  • Capture photos, videos, field information, and new innovations/challenges during trainings, symposia, conferences, and farm visits; perform basic video editing as needed.
  • Ensure content reflects ECHO’s technical excellence, faith-based values, and regional realities.
  1. Channels & Community Engagement
  • Manage and grow CAC regional social media channels by sharing strategic updates, technical resources, impact stories, and network member highlights.
  • Facilitate and strengthen WhatsApp communities in coordination with leadership and technical staff by sharing training materials, technical resources, success stories, videos, and relevant updates.
  • Receive, respond, monitor, and route organizational communications to the Regional Director or appropriate team members.
  1. Event Communications and Regional Engagement Support
  • Support the organization and execution of courses, workshops, symposia, and other events through promotion, invitations, and logistical coordination.
  • Prepare institutional reports, summaries, and communication outputs following events and regional activities.
  1. Coordination with Consultants and Contractors
  • Coordinate external communications, marketing, and creative service providers to ensure alignment with ECHO’s brand standards, messaging priorities, and regional communication objectives.
  • Develop and maintain an up-to-date institutional directory of partners, strategic allies, network members, and key stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain a roster of regional professionals to serve as a pool of consultants.
QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIRED SKILLS:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills and/or abilities required.
  • Must subscribe to the ECHO Statement of Faith and possess character traits consistent with ECHO’s core values.
  • Fluency in Spanish and advanced proficiency in English.
  • Knowledge of Indigenous or local languages and/or Haitian Creole is considered an asset.
