title: Senior Architect (Microsoft Power Apps)
description:
Solution Architect #1089

Microsoft Enterprise Architecture • Power Platform • Azure • .NET/C# • Secure SaaS/PaaS Solutions

Location: Falls Church, VA – Client Site (Hybrid – onsite 3 days/week)

Clearance: US Citizenship required, must be able to obtain DOJ Public Trust

A Role with Purpose and Impact

Dev Technology is supporting the modernization of a mission-critical federal scheduling and workflow platform built on the Microsoft ecosystem. This role is responsible for defining a secure, scalable, and maintainable enterprise architecture that aligns business needs with the Government's Microsoft-based enterprise environment.

You will work across business, application, data, integration, security, infrastructure, and delivery teams to design solutions leveraging Microsoft Power Platform, Azure, Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365, and modern .NET technologies. The role requires strong technical judgment, experience evaluating SaaS, PaaS, and hybrid architectures, and a practical commitment to configuration-first solutions while minimizing custom development.

This position is ideal for a senior technical leader who can establish architectural direction, communicate technical tradeoffs to executive and technical stakeholders, and remain engaged throughout implementation to ensure architectural integrity from design through production.

Architecture Leadership and Technical Delivery

This role blends enterprise architecture leadership with hands-on technical guidance. You will:

  • Design end-to-end solution architecture across application, integration, data, security, infrastructure, environments, and deployment
  • Architect Microsoft Power Platform solutions including Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Power Pages
  • Design scalable Azure-based solutions utilizing Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, Logic Apps, Azure Service Bus, Azure SQL, and other Azure Integration Services
  • Define modular system components, APIs, data models, security controls, availability, scalability, and performance strategies
  • Guide configuration and extension of Microsoft SaaS and PaaS capabilities while minimizing custom code
  • Design integrations using REST APIs, Microsoft Graph, Azure Integration Services, .NET services, and enterprise messaging patterns
  • Lead architecture reviews, evaluate design alternatives, and incorporate Government feedback into technical architecture artifacts
  • Collaborate with development teams using C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Power Platform custom components when extensions are required

You will remain engaged throughout delivery by reviewing solution designs, application configurations, .NET code, Power Platform implementations, Azure resources, integration approaches, and production readiness activities while ensuring architecture documentation remains current.

Who Thrives Here

Successful architects in this role:

  • Balance enterprise architecture with practical delivery
  • Understand both low-code Power Platform solutions and enterprise software development
  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Design secure Microsoft cloud solutions that meet Federal compliance requirements
  • Prefer modular, standards-based, cloud-native architectures over unnecessary customization
  • Partner effectively with infrastructure, cybersecurity, DevSecOps, application development, and business teams
  • Bring thoughtful leadership to complex technical and modernization initiatives

This position offers the opportunity to shape the Microsoft technology foundation of a mission-critical federal modernization program—from solution architecture and platform design through implementation, integrations, testing, deployment, and long-term operational success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain enterprise solution architecture documentation, diagrams, and technical specifications
  • Design Microsoft Power Platform solutions including Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Power Pages
  • Architect Azure cloud services and hybrid environments aligned with Government enterprise standards
  • Design .NET-based services, APIs, reusable components, and integration frameworks
  • Define application, data, security, deployment, and role-based access control architectures
  • Design RESTful APIs, Azure API Management policies, authentication, authorization, data validation, exception handling, retry strategies, and messaging patterns
  • Architect integrations with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Microsoft Graph, Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, SQL Server, and external Government systems
  • Ensure compliance with Federal security requirements including Zero Trust principles, FedRAMP, NIST, and DOJ security standards
  • Define scalable deployment architectures utilizing Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and automated release processes
  • Support architecture governance, design reviews, integration testing, performance testing, production readiness, cutover, and operational stabilization
  • Guide solution development teams through architectural decisions while ensuring alignment with enterprise standards
  • Design AI-enabled capabilities using Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, or Azure AI Services so they can be disabled or restricted without impacting mission-critical operations
  • Ensure Government data is protected and not transmitted to external AI services or used for model training without explicit authorization

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience designing and delivering enterprise applications using Microsoft technologies
  • 5+ years serving as a Solution Architect, Enterprise Architect, Application Architect, or Integration Architect
  • Demonstrated experience delivering Microsoft Power Platform, Azure, Dynamics 365, or Microsoft cloud solutions
  • Strong experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Power Pages, and Microsoft 365 integrations
  • Experience designing enterprise applications using C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Web APIs, and SQL Server
  • Experience architecting Azure cloud solutions including App Services, Functions, API Management, Logic Apps, Azure Service Bus, Storage, and Azure SQL
  • Strong understanding of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, RBAC, and enterprise identity management
  • Experience designing REST APIs, enterprise integrations, data migration strategies, messaging, and event-driven architectures
  • Experience working within secure Federal, DOJ, or other regulated environments
  • Experience creating architecture diagrams, technical specifications, deployment architectures, and data models
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting DOJ, EOIR, courts, case management, scheduling, or workflow modernization initiatives
  • Microsoft Power Platform Solution Architect Expert certification
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert
  • Experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Case Management, or Government Accelerator solutions
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, ARM, Terraform), and DevSecOps practices
  • Experience with FedRAMP High, Microsoft GCC High, Azure Government, or other Federal cloud environments
  • Experience leading enterprise data migration, production cutover, operational readiness, and system stabilization
  • AWS or other cloud architecture certifications are a plus

Our estimated salary range for this position is $140,000-$165,000, this presented salary range is not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Offered salary is based on experience, geographic location, and possibly contractual requirements as appropriate to the role. *Salary could fall outside of this range.

Who We Are

Dev Technology is a growing IT company with an employee-centric culture that works on mission-critical projects for the federal government. We partner with our federal customers to deliver technology services and solutions, and to drive our client’s missions forward through innovation. We use Agile and DevSecOps principles to provide services including application development, biometrics and identity management, cloud and infrastructure optimization, IT and legacy modernization, and data management.

As a Washington Post Top Workplace award winner for the past THIRTEEN years in a row, the Top Workplaces USA for the past five years, and a recipient of the Companies As Responsive Employers (CARE) Award for the past six years, Dev Technology employees enjoy:

title: Validation Engineer
description:
Valspec—a global provider of system validation and lifecycle services—provides commissioning and qualification of computerized systems for clients in the Life Sciences industry. Established in 1999, Valspec’s mission is to provide a wide spectrum of services that help its clients meet their capital project and lifecycle maintenance goals.

Valspec’s projects are critical to the industry, and to the people who rely on its products. Many projects ensure that life-changing drugs are available to those who need them; others streamline production to meet demand at a lower cost, allowing for the discovery of new and innovative therapies.

VALIDATION ENGINEER

Location: Royersford, PA

The ideal candidate is a recent engineering graduate with an interest in automation and control systems used in life sciences manufacturing (vaccines, biologics, cell and gene therapy). Experience as a Co-Op or Intern in life sciences, chemical or industrial engineering, energy, or manufacturing preferred. This particular role is in Pennsylvania but may require travel on occasion.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • The ultimate goal of a Valspec validation engineer is to test computer systems that manufacture pharmaceuticals, vaccines, cell and gene therapy products, and other biologics at our clients. Testing to make sure a manufacturing process can be performed effectively every time ensures the safety of pharmaceutical products.
  • Computer systems to be tested may include programmable logic controllers (PLC), Emerson DeltaV distributed control systems (DCS), manufacturing execution systems (MES), and data historians (OSI PI).
  • As part of an internal project team or supporting a client at their site, this role will interact with cross-functional groups to perform installation and operational (IOQ) testing.
  • Examples of items to be tested include Emerson DeltaV chassis, servers, controllers, network switches, virtual machines, batch execution, security and HMI configuration.
    • Execute Process Control System (PCS) Installation/Operational (IOQ) protocols.
    • Author project deviations for failed test scripts and execute any necessary retesting.
    • Draft and support review cycle of qualification summary reports.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Recent college degree in engineering with an interest in control systems testing.
  • Preferably held an internship or co-op that provided a broad technical base of experience in the SDLC of automated systems (process controls, MES, and/or data management).
  • Displays fundamental knowledge of process and understanding of engineering documents, process control (to include PLC/DCS/SCADA), networks, control systems and application engineering.
  • Experience with Emerson DeltaV and/or Allen Bradley, Rockwell, Siemens, Honeywell controllers and interfaces are strongly preferred, but not required.
  • Prior experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical or similar FDA regulated industry is preferred, but not required.
  • Experience in the development and execution of test plans, IQ, OQ, PQ validation protocols for new or upgraded integrated factory floor systems is a plus.

Join a great team with interesting projects at top notch clients. Apply Today!

BENEFITS

  • Premium medical and dental insurance options
  • 401K matching
  • Bonus potential
  • Paid time off, including holidays

Why Join Valspec?

At Valspec, we offer more than just a job — we provide a career experience rooted in a standout culture, collaborative environment, and a strong sense of ownership. As an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) company, every team member has a stake in our success, fostering a shared commitment to excellence and innovation. We also offer a highly competitive benefits package, including:

  • Premium medical coverage
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Unique performance incentives
  • And more — all designed to support your growth, well-being, and future.

Join a team where your contributions matter, your development is prioritized, and your success is shared.

Candidates must be legally eligible to work in the United States without company sponsorship. Also, we are not interested in working on a corp-to-corp basis with other companies at this time.

Any third-party unsolicited resume submission(s) will immediately become the property of Valspec. Valspec will not pay any fee to a submitting employment agency, person, or entity unless a signed agreement is established.

title: Chef d'équipe développement logiciel C++ / Lead Software Developer, C++
description:
À propos d'Exegy

Exegy est un chef de file mondial des données de marché intelligentes, des systèmes de négociation avancés et des technologies tournées vers l'avenir. Exegy agit comme un partenaire de confiance pour l'ensemble de l'écosystème financier : sociétés de gestion (buy-side), courtiers (sell-side), bourses et entreprises de technologies financières à travers le monde. Basée à Saint-Louis et dotée de bureaux régionaux en Amérique du Nord, au Royaume-Uni/Europe et en Asie-Pacifique, Exegy possède une présence mondiale lui permettant de fournir un soutien et des services gérés de premier ordre à sa clientèle composée d'acteurs d'élite des marchés financiers.

Résumé du poste

Exegy est à la recherche d'un(e) Chef d'équipe développement logiciel C++ très motivé(e) pour se joindre à notre groupe d'ingénierie des données de marché à Montréal. Évoluant dans un environnement technologique hautement collaboratif, vous agirez à titre de leader technique pour notre équipe de gestionnaires de flux (feedhandlers) à Montréal, avec la vision et le mandat d'étendre potentiellement ce leadership technique à l'échelle mondiale.

À ce titre, vous combinerez des fondations très solides en C++, des pratiques d'ingénierie modernes et une passion pour le leadership agile. Vous dirigerez l'architecture, la conception et la livraison d'applications multithreadées à très faible latence et critiques en matière de temps de traitement, qui interagissent avec les dispositifs d'accélération matérielle sur mesure d'Exegy. En plus de rédiger du code haute performance, vous piloterez les processus agiles, faciliterez le flux de travail de l'équipe, alignerez les objectifs d'affaires avec l'exécution technique et promouvrez une culture axée sur l'automatisation.

Responsabilités principales

Leadership technique et architecture

  • Responsabilité technique des feedhandlers : Agir à titre de leader technique sur le terrain pour l'équipe de Montréal, en orientant les choix techniques avec la possibilité d'influencer l'architecture globale des gestionnaires de flux.

  • Architecture et performance : Assumer la vision technique, la fiabilité des systèmes, l'extensibilité (scalabilité) et la maintenabilité des systèmes C++ à très faible latence et hautement performants.

  • Pratiques d'ingénierie modernes : Promouvoir les méthodologies de développement modernes et les outils d'aide aux développeurs (par exemple, en tirant parti de workflows en ligne de commande comme Gemini CLI, de patrons de conception C++ modernes et du profilage automatisé) afin d'accroître la productivité de l'équipe.

  • Culture d'automatisation et de qualité : Ancrer une culture rigoureuse axée sur les tests et l'automatisation, en veillant à la rédaction de tests unitaires solides pour chaque nouvelle fonctionnalité et code réinventé (refactorisé).

Gestion et processus agiles

  • Facilitation agile : Animer les cérémonies et pratiques agiles, y compris la facilitation des réunions d'équipe, la définition des épiques (epics), la répartition des billets (tickets) et la planification des sprints.

  • Mise en œuvre des processus : Établir, appliquer et faire respecter les normes d'ingénierie, les flux de travail et les processus de revue de code au sein de l'équipe, en garantissant leur respect à long terme.

  • Alignement affaires et développement : Agir comme pont principal entre les parties prenantes du produit/des affaires et l'équipe d'ingénierie afin d'aligner directement les solutions techniques sur les besoins commerciaux.

Ingénierie logicielle principale

  • Développement de systèmes à faible latence : Concevoir, implémenter, documenter et déboguer des gestionnaires de flux C++ réutilisables et extensibles pour les marchés d'actions, d'options, de matières premières, de titres à revenu fixe et de devises (FX).

  • Intégration matérielle : Développer des applications qui interagissent directement avec les cartes et composants d'accélération matérielle FPGA sur mesure d'Exegy.

  • Soutien aux opérations : Collaborer avec les responsables de comptes techniques (TAM) et l'équipe des opérations pour résoudre les problèmes, optimiser et soutenir les systèmes en production.

Culture d'entreprise et croissance de l'équipe

  • Environnement collaboratif : Favoriser une culture technologique transparente, entraide et hautement collaborative au sein du bureau de Montréal.

  • Mentorat : Encadrer et guider les ingénieurs en soutenant leur maturité technique, l'adoption des meilleures pratiques et leur progression professionnelle.

  • Recrutement et constitution de l'équipe : Participer aux entrevues et au processus de recrutement afin d'attirer les meilleurs talents en ingénierie.

Profil recherché :

Leadership et esprit agile

  • Aptitudes de leadership : Désir marqué et capacité démontrée à diriger, faciliter et promouvoir les flux de travail agiles (définition des épiques, attribution des billets, animation des rétrospectives et des sprints).

  • Mise en place de processus : Capacité éprouvée à définir les processus d'équipe et à en assurer le respect à long terme.

  • Vision et évolution : Ambition de prendre en charge le leadership technique de la suite de gestionnaires de flux de Montréal et d'assumer progressivement des responsabilités de leadership technique à l'échelle mondiale.

Maîtrise technique et bonnes pratiques

  • Fondations en C++ : Au moins 7 ans d'expérience en développement logiciel C++ multithreadé, avec une compréhension approfondie de la programmation concurrente, de la gestion de la mémoire et de la conception à faible latence.

  • Expérience en leadership : Au moins 2 ans dans un rôle de leadership technique ou de chef d'équipe guidant des développeurs tout au long du cycle de vie du développement logiciel (SDLC).

  • Outillage et ingénierie modernes : Expérience pratique avec des outils d'ingénierie modernes (outils CLI, cadres d'automatisation) et habileté démontrée à appliquer les patrons de conception logicielle et l'architecture orientée objet propre.

  • Souci de la qualité : Engagement envers les tests automatisés (cadres de tests unitaires), le profilage, la détection des fuites de mémoire et l'intégration continue.

  • Environnement Linux : Excellente maîtrise des systèmes d'exploitation Linux (RedHat, CentOS, SUSE) et des outils de développement et de débogage sous Linux.

Connaissances du domaine, culture et communication

  • Expérience du domaine : Expérience des données de marché financier, des marchés de capitaux, de la négociation algorithmique ou des plateformes de distribution à haute fréquence (fortement souhaitée).

  • Culture collaborative : Capacité naturelle à s'intégrer dans un environnement d'ingénierie axé sur le travail d'équipe et la collaboration.

  • Compétences linguistiques : Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (parlé et écrit) requise pour le bureau de Montréal.

  • Emplacement : Capacité à travailler selon un modèle hybride avec une présence au bureau de Montréal.

_______________________________________________________________________________

About Exegy

Exegy is a global leader in intelligent market data, advanced trading systems, and future-proof technology. Exegy serves as a trusted partner to the complete ecosystem of the buy-side, sell-side, exchanges, and financial services technology firms around the globe. Headquartered in St. Louis with regional offices in North America, the UK/Europe, and Asia Pacific, Exegy has the global footprint to deliver world-class support and managed services to its customer base of elite financial market participants.

Job Summary

Exegy is seeking a highly motivated Lead C++ Software Developer to join our Market Data Engineering group in Montreal. Operating in a highly collaborative tech environment, you will serve as the technical lead for our Montreal feedhandler group, with the vision and mandate to potentially expand technical leadership on a global scale.

In this role, you will combine rock-solid C++ fundamentals with modern engineering practices and a passion for Agile leadership. You will lead the architecture, design, and delivery of time-critical, ultra-low latency, multi-threaded applications that interact with Exegy’s custom hardware acceleration devices. Beyond writing high-performance code, you will drive Agile processes, facilitate team workflows, align business goals with developer execution, and foster an automation-first culture.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Feedhandler Technical Ownership: Serve as the hands-on technical lead for the Montreal feedhandler team, driving technical direction with the scope to influence feedhandler architecture globally.

  • Architecture & Performance: Own the technical vision, system reliability, scalability, and maintainability for performance-sensitive, ultra-low latency C++ systems.

  • Modern Engineering Practices: Champion modern development methodologies and developer tools (e.g., leveraging CLI workflows like Gemini CLI, modern C++ patterns, and automated profiling) to elevate team productivity.

  • Automation & Quality Mindset: Embed a strict "test-first/automation" culture, ensuring robust unit tests are written for all new features and refactored code.

Agile & Process Management

  • Agile Facilitation: Lead Agile practices and ceremonies, including facilitating team meetings, defining epics, and overseeing ticket assignments and sprint planning.

  • Process Implementation: Establish, implement, and enforce team engineering standards, workflows, and code review processes, ensuring long-term adherence across the team.

  • Business & Dev Alignment: Act as the primary bridge between product/business stakeholders and the engineering team to align technical solutions directly with business needs.

Core Software Engineering

  • Build Low-Latency Systems: Design, implement, document, and debug reusable, extensible C++ feed handlers across Equities, Options, Commodities, Fixed Income, and Foreign Exchange (FX) markets.

  • Hardware Integration: Develop applications that interface directly with Exegy’s custom FPGA hardware acceleration devices.

  • Operations Support: Partner with Technical Account Managers (TAMs) and Operations to troubleshoot, optimize, and support production systems.

Culture & Team Growth

  • Collaborative Environment: Cultivate a transparent, supportive, and highly collaborative tech culture in the Montreal office.

  • Mentorship: Coach engineers, guiding their technical maturity, adherence to best practices, and career progression.

  • Hiring & Team Building: Participate in interviewing and hiring to attract top engineering talent.

Our Ideal Candidate Has:

Leadership & Agile Mindset

  • Leadership Drive: A strong desire and demonstrated capability to lead, facilitate, and champion Agile workflows (epic definitions, ticket assignments, retro/sprint facilitation).

  • Process Ownership: Proven ability to define team processes and ensure long-term team adherence.

  • Scope & Growth: Ambition to own technical leadership for the Montreal feedhandler suite and step into broader global technical leadership responsibilities.

Technical Mastery & Best Practices

  • C++ Fundamentals: 7+ years of multithreaded C++ software development with a deep understanding of concurrent programming, memory management, and low-latency design.

  • Leadership Experience: 2+ years in a technical leadership or engineering lead role guiding teams through the full Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).

  • Modern Tooling & Engineering: Hands-on experience with modern engineering tools (CLI tools, automation frameworks) and a track record of applying software design patterns and clean OO architecture.

  • Quality Focus: Strong commitment to automated testing (unit testing frameworks), profiling, memory leak detection, and continuous integration.

  • Linux Environment: Strong command of Linux operating systems (RedHat, CentOS, SUSE) and Linux development/debugging tools.

Domain, Culture & Communication

  • Domain Experience: Experience in financial market data, capital markets, algorithmic trading, or high-frequency distribution platforms is highly desirable.

  • Collaborative Culture: Fits naturally into a highly collaborative, team-oriented engineering environment.

  • Language Skills: Fluency in French and English (written and spoken) required for the Montreal office.

  • Location: Ability to work in a hybrid model with presence in the Montreal office.

title: Investor Relations Consultant
description:
Investor Relations at Private Equity Insights

This role offers you the opportunity to expand and nurture our community of key VIP groups such as institutional investors (LPs) and other key stakeholders in the Private Equity Industry.
Do you want to take part in defining the future of Private Equity? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about people and building relationships? If so, you might be our next member of the investor relations team.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 500k followers on LinkedIn organising a series of 12 global private equity events every year with 2,000+ GPs, 1,000+ LPs among the attendees.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media () which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

You get the unique opportunity to take ownership of one of our key business areas. You’ll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never-ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • The opportunity of having a real impact - You’ll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.
  • Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company.
  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.
  • Travel opportunity: You would be joining our conferences overseas.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.

Your Responsibilities

Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:

  • Identify, maintain and develop long-standing and fruitful relationships with institutional investors who can benefit from the targeted offering of our product and network
  • Accommodate the investment strategy of the LP by facilitating 1:1 meetings with relevant fund managers
  • Support the team to fulfil delivery of our exclusive products such as roundtables, panel sessions, and VIP receptions. This may sometimes require securing an audience that extends beyond our usual definition of institutional investors, such as GPs

What the future hold for you with our company

Whether you are with or for 2 or 10+ years we believe this position to lay the foundation for a very successful career. We are strong believers of internal promotions and aim to land all management positions internally, and with 45% of our people exiting to PE/Venture or M&A it emphasizes the opportunity arising from this company.

What we expect from you

Please note that this job does not require any specific previous work experience as training is provided and we are looking to incorporate candidates across different levels of experience. However, we do require you to have a UK work permit.

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:

title: Services Lead, Beach Volleyball
description:
LA28 does not provide relocation assistance.

LA28 is the independent, non-profit, privately funded organizing committee for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games. We are on a singular mission to create an Olympic and Paralympic Games that celebrate all that this city and country have to offer, delivering an unparalleled experience for athletes, fans, partners and our community.

The 2028 Games mark the return of the Summer Games to the U.S. for the first time in 32 years and Los Angeles’ third time hosting an Olympic Games and first time welcoming the Paralympic Games. This presents the unique and exciting opportunity to celebrate our legacy with the Games and push the Olympic and Paralympic Movements forward, writing a new chapter of Games history in Los Angeles.

Putting on an Olympic and Paralympic Games is a team sport. To build a Games unlike any the world has seen before, we need the best team in place–a team full of perspectives, experiences and expertise. We are guided by the following set of values and behaviors–optimism, integrity, excellence, inclusion, co-creation and boldness–and look forward to hearing about how your past experiences align with them.

Services Lead, Beach Volleyball

Position Summary

Within this division, LA28 is looking for a Senior Associate, Beach Volleyball. Under the authority of the Beach Volleyball Sport Manager, the Senior Associate is responsible for the planning, organization, coordination, and management of the administrative functions of Beach Volleyball/Blind Football events at the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games.

The Senior Associate ed to relay and facilitate critical services for key stakeholder groups, such as athletes, International Federations and technical officials. They will also coordinate sports information with the various divisions of LA28, participate in the planning and operations of test events, coordinate the recruitment of sports staff, as well as the recruitment and training of volunteers needed for competitions in their sport.

Key Responsibilities

Pre Games Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, and be the dedicated sport contact person in organizing visits from the International Federation in coordination with the IF Services Team and Head of Competition Management.

  • Act as the dedicated sports contact for coordinating services-related matters with the International Federation, including accommodation, transportation, accreditation, and hospitality.

  • Advocate for and coordinate all sport stakeholders’ services including Athletes, Technical Officials, IF Staff and IF guests.

  • Create and ensure organized follow-up of the sharing of databases related to key topics of the Sport Delivery Plan between the International Federation and the various departments of LA28

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for NOC/NPC services teams to establish an effective communication channel in preparation for their visits and information requests.

  • Support the Sport Manager to ensure that all operational procedures and processes of LA28 are understood and followed.

  • Collaborate with the Sport Manager and the head of technical operations for the coordination of the teams and administrative operations: monitoring, updating, and sharing the database and various resource documents, planning management, and of the organization, team meetings, etc.

  • Work closely with the Sport Manager, the technical operations lead, the National Federation, and the LA28 Workforce team to recruit, train, and ensure the operational management of sport-specific volunteers.

  • Collaborate with the Sport Manager and the technical operations lead to recruit, train, and deploy the team responsible for delivering the competitions.

  • Work closely with the Sport Manager, the International Federation, and the National Federation for the selection and training of the National Technical Officials (NTOs) required for the Olympic and Paralympic Games.

  • Manage all other tasks and projects related to the delivery of competitions as requested by the Sport Manager.

  • Collaborate with the IF Services and Relations Manager to ensure sharing of information and tools with the services team and other stakeholders.

Games Time Responsibilities

  • Coordinate the following matters within the sport during the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games:

  • Services for athletes

  • Services for the International Federation

  • Services for international and national officials

  • Sport Information

  • Volunteers

  • Manage a team of full-time employees including scheduling, task delegation, training and on-site management

  • Manage a team of Sport Specific Volunteers including recruitment, retention, training, scheduling, recognition and task delegation

  • Act as point of contact with LA28 Functional areas to solve Games Time issues

  • Act as point of contact with the International Federation team to identify and solve Games Time issues.

Background and Requirements

  • Experience collaborating with National and International Federations and knowledge of their structure and functioning during national and international events.

  • Ability to demonstrate an understanding and knowledge of the operational elements required for organizing major sports events/competitions.

  • Experience in international sporting events.

  • Experience in working with an International Federation and knowledge of their structure and operation is an advantage

  • Experience of working with a National Sport Federation and knowledge of its structure and operation at domestic and international events is an advantage

  • Experience managing a team (staff and volunteers) at major events.

  • Good understanding and knowledge of project management, including planning and producing tracking documents.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects involving numerous stakeholders.

  • Skills in report writing and presentation materials.

  • Knowledge of the Olympic and Paralympic Games as well as the specific sport’s technical requirements is an advantage.

  • Proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, as well as Outlook, Teams, SharePoint).

  • Excellent level of English, both written and spoken, is essential for this position.

  • Long-term interest and involvement in Olympic and Paralympic sports.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

  • Available to work onsite in our Downtown Los Angeles-based office.

  • The majority of work will be conducted in an office setting, requiring extended periods of time using computers, phones, and other office equipment.

  • The LA28 office is an open floorplan working environment; employees must be able to work efficiently in an open cubicle environment.

  • Hours of work may vary, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, especially during peak event periods.

  • Perform other duties as required; the role will evolve over time and may include operational responsibilities during the Olympic and Paralympic Games.

  • Ability to be outdoors in the elements for long periods of time including sun, wind, rain, etc.

Expectations

  • Understanding and ability to use project management tools is a must.

  • Rigor and very good organizational skills.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • Strong level of commitment to achieve objectives.

  • Willingness to work in a team spirit.

  • Autonomous and proactive.

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm to continuously develop knowledge and skills.

  • Flexible and open-minded in a dynamic environment.

  • Very good interpersonal skills and great adaptability.

  • Knows how to manage time, meet deadlines, and approach projects in a structured manner.

  • Enthusiastic about sport and about the Olympic and Paralympic Movement.

  • Understands and is committed to LA28’s vision, mission, and values.

  • Seeks ways to continuously improve the way things are done.

  • Willing to assist and work with other sport managers/sports.

  • Proficient in excel, word, PDF Power point

The annual base salary range for this position is $73,000 - $98,000. The pay scale provided is the range that LA28 reasonably expects to pay as starting base compensation for this role. All LA28 compensation remains subject to final determination based on individual candidate qualifications, experience, or other reasonable criteria consistent with LA28’s operational business needs and applicable law.

title: Lane Closure Technician (LCT)
description:
Are you a hardworking and growth oriented individual looking to make a career switch?


The Universal Group, recognized as one of Canada's Best Managed companies in 2025, has exciting opportunities in our Traffic Control team. As a Lane Closure Technician (LCT), you play an essential role in supporting the safety of your fellow roadworkers, crews and members of public on the road. You will be responsible for the safe and efficient set up, maintenance, and removal of traffic control measures in various work zones across the lower mainland. You will work with contractors involved in heavy underground, light utility, electrical, paving, road building, and special events. You role will be instrumental in ensuring safety and regulatory compliance while minimizing traffic disruptions, upholding standards, and providing a secure work environment for our teams and community.


What you will be responsible for:


Traffic Control

  • Lead Traffic Control persons, providing direction and guidance to set up and tear down signs, work zone delineations, and ensure safe traffic control.
  • Set up traffic control zones.
  • Give clear and precise traffic control directions and signals for motorists' understanding.
  • Monitor the traffic and work zone and modify when scope of work changes.


Safety and Compliance

  • Effectively conduct traffic control at worksites within the scope of training to protect workers, the public, and our employees.
  • Comply with all Acts, Regulations, Guidelines, Policies, and Procedures for health and safety.
  • Participate in accident/incident investigations as required and complete necessary forms and reports for due diligence and compliance.


Special Events and Meetings

  • Conduct traffic control at Special Events when required, following the direction of the company's Special Events coordinator.
  • Attend health and safety tool-box/tailgate meetings to discuss work related matters.
  • Hazards must be addressed in a Field Level Risk Assessment (FLRA) and must be complete prior to work commencing.


Reporting and Communication

  • Report directly to the contractor's site supervisor, taking their direction for traffic control setup and safety if no Lane Closure Technician or Traffic Control Supervisor from the company is on-site.
  • Report health and safety matters, non-compliance issues, or conflicts with any company employee to the company's Area Manager or Health and Safety Officer.


Safety Gear and Equipment

  • Always wear all personal protective equipment (PPE) as required by WorkSafeBC regulations or site safety rules, policies, or procedures.
  • Use proper protocol when using two-way radios and refrain from the use of profane or vulgar language.


Certification and Training

  • Ensures the BC Traffic Control Person (TCP) certificate is maintained to be current and valid at all times.


What you get from us:

  • Signing bonus of $1000 for experienced LCTs (terms and conditions apply).
  • A new company pickup truck and gas card!
  • A highly experienced and knowledgeable Health & Safety department dedicated to your safety on site.
  • Excellent total compensation package and vacation pay paid out on every cheque.
  • Exclusive Corporate Discounts (TELUS, HelloFresh, etc.).
  • Medical and Dental benefit coverage after probationary period.
  • Opportunities for growth into higher level positions, including field, operations and health and safety positions.


What we need from you:

  • Minimum 6 months of BC LCT experience.
  • Current TCP certification recognized by WorkSafeBC or equivalent provincial regulator.
  • Drivers License with a clean driving record.
  • Possession of and ability to use a smartphone with a data plan.
  • Good knowledge and understanding of the WorkSafeBC Regulations for Traffic Control, Part 18.
  • Knowledge and understanding of the WCB Act, sections 115-117, General Duties.
  • Knowledge and understanding of the Traffic Management Plans and Traffic Management Manual for Work on Roadways as developed by the Ministry of Transportation and Infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of the requirements of the British Columbia Motor Vehicle Act and other regulations related to traffic control.
  • Ensures accountability - holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.
  • Collaborates - Builds partnerships and works collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
  • Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively.
  • Directs Work - Provides directions, delegates, and removes obstacles to get work done.
  • Situational adaptability - adapting approach and demeanor in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations.
  • Plans and aligns - plans and prioritizes work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.


Where/When you will be working:

  • Dispatchable region across the Interior.
  • Available 5 weekdays (Mon-Fri).
  • Occasional weekend work available.
  • Working outdoors in all elements and weather.


The recruitment process for this role typically lasts 1 week and includes a phone screen, behavioral assessment and an in-person interview.

Why Universal Group?


The Universal Group is driven by our purpose to provide Peace of Mind to both our clients and team members. Our people embrace our core values of being ‘Passionate, Authentic, and Driven’ in everything we do and in every decision we make every day. They are the fabric of who we are and, without question, the reason for our success and continued growth.


The safety of our team members and the public drives us daily.


The Universal Group is an industry leader in traffic control services, traffic management planning, traffic equipment supply, landscaping, temporary labour and occupational health and safety training. We are a one-stop shop, as our full suite of services ensures that we can manage projects from conception to completion.


For more information about the company, please visit our Indeed Profile!



Our Commitment to Diversity


The Universal Group is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.


We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, colour, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic.

Do you want to take part in defining the future of Private Equity? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 500k followers on LinkedIn organising a series of 12 global private equity events every year with 2,000+ GPs, 1,000+ LPs among the attendees.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media () which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

You get the unique opportunity to take ownership of one of our key business areas. You’ll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never-ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • The opportunity of having a real impact - You’ll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.

  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.
  • Travel opportunity: You would be joining our conferences overseas.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.

Your Responsibilities

Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:

  • Identify, maintain and develop long-standing and fruitful relationships with institutional investors who can benefit from the targeted offering of our product and network
  • Accommodate the investment strategy of the LP by facilitating 1:1 meetings with relevant fund managers
  • Support the team to fulfil delivery of our exclusive products such as roundtables, panel sessions, and VIP receptions. This may sometimes require securing an audience that extends beyond our usual definition of institutional investors, such as GPs

What the future hold for you with our company

Whether you are with or for 2 or 10+ years we believe this position to lay the foundation for a very successful career. We are strong believers of internal promotions and aim to land all management positions internally, and with 45% of our people exiting to PE/Venture or M&A it emphasizes the opportunity arising from this company.

What we expect from you

Please note that this job does not require any specific previous work experience as training is provided and we are looking to incorporate candidates across different levels of experience. However, we do require you to have a UK work permit.

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:

Start date

Flexible

The role is onsite, Monday to Friday, based in our offices at Sloane Square. It is essential we work at a fast pace and collaborate in person to create market-leading, unmatched events throughout the calendar year. It will be great to have you as part of our team.

title: Production Technician - Mechanical
description:

Re:Build Fikst, a Re:Build Manufacturing company, is a dynamic product development and engineering consulting firm located in Wilmington, MA. We work with pioneering clients to develop their technology, design their products, and bring those products to production. Re:Build Fikst's areas of expertise include industrial automation, robotics, biomedical instruments and consumables, microfluidics, specialty plastic design, optics, and design for manufacturing. We have extensive in-house laboratory and rapid prototyping capability including CNCs, 3D printers and laser cutters, which help facilitate our ability to prototype and innovate fast. title: PLM Administrator
description:

Astro Mechanica is a vertically integrated aerospace company building a faster, more connected future. Our mission is to democratize high-speed flight by making supersonic travel flexible, accessible, and sustainable. We believe that rapid, on-demand, point-to-point global mobility will become the new standard for moving people and goods across the planet. To achieve this, we are integrating our advanced airframe and engine technologies—which include Duality™, our proprietary dual-use propulsion system—with a new flight operations model to make supersonic transport as efficient and economical as commercial air travel is today. You'll architect, implement, and continuously improve our engineering systems, including Teamcenter, NX, automation, enterprise applications, and the infrastructure that supports them. PERKS & BENEFITS:

At Astro Mechanica, we highly value in-office work to foster collaboration and strengthen our company culture. We consider working in the office five days a week an essential part of the employee's role.

Astro Mechanica is an equal opportunity employer. We proudly recruit and hire a diverse workforce and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

We are creating smarter ways to address heart disease and heart risks by uniting patients, care teams, and researchers on a secure, technology-enabled platform that drives clinical innovation and offers a path towards better patient outcomes.

This is precision cardiology, and we know it’s within reach.

What Will You Do?

The Overview

The Principal Product Designer to own the end-to-end design of our products — from early-stage discovery through polished, production-ready interfaces. This is a foundational hire at a critical stage of growth. You will be the design voice in the room: following standards, collaborating with Product & Engineering, and delivering work that meets both the needs of clinicians and patients.

This individual contributor role is ideal for a seasoned generalist who is comfortable with ambiguity and confident in using their craft to create clarity. A strong candidate will be equally skilled in gathering requirements, building information architecture, and crafting high-fidelity UI.

The Specifics

  • Define and drive long-term product vision and design strategy for multiple products. Lead complex, ambiguous design problems from conceptual exploration through detailed execution.
  • Partner with Product Manager and Engineering teams to conduct workshops, feature definition, and stakeholder management
  • Collaborate with clinical, regulatory, and legal teams to translate user needs into design artifacts and specifications
  • Design high-fidelity mockups and interactive prototypes for user research and development handoff
  • Update organization regularly on product design progress.
  • Represent the design perspective for broad, non-technical audience

Why Prolaio?

  • Impactful Work: You will join in the fight against heart failure (HF) and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) with the goal of extending and saving the lives of our patients while also being at the forefront of changing the healthcare industry through technology.
  • Innovative Environment: You will be part of an organization doing something that’s never been done before.
  • Professional Growth: You will join a growing team and have a substantial impact on our daily and future operations with the opportunity to continuously learn and grow.
  • Collaborative Team: You will be part of a team of collaborative, curious, and committed individuals focused on the collective good, inclusiveness, scientific excellence, and advancing digital health for cardiology.

Who You Are?

  • 7+ years of product or UX/UI design experience, including 3 years in a senior or principal-level role
  • Portfolio demonstrating end-to-end of complex product design, ranging from long term product vision, to detailed execution
  • Hands-on experience designing for regulated industries, preferably medical devices, health IT, or clinical software
  • Strong organization, written, and verbal communication skills, including ability to document design rationale and detailed specifications.
  • Working understanding of product management and development processes, with demonstrated experience collaborating with those disciplines

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Meaningful Compensation: Competitive salary, performance bonus, and equity so you can share in what we build.

description:

Summary
SSP International, Inc. (SSPI) is a non-profit organization that is synonymous with excellence in science education. At SSPI, we are guided by a mission to offer students transformational opportunities to learn, do, and belong in science. Since 1959, SSPI’s flagship program, the Summer Science Program, has offered immersive summer research experiences that ignite curiosity and inspire a lifelong passion for discovery. Guided by our mission, SSPI is focused on embracing collaboration, building a lifelong community, and fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where participants, alumni, staff, and stakeholders feel valued, supported, and empowered. With a global network of over 4,300 alumni, we continue to pave the way for the next generation of leaders.
More information on our mission, vision, values, and programs can be found at www.ssp.org.

About the STEM Learning Institute
In January 2026, SSPI launched the STEM Learning Institute. The STEM Learning Institute pairs research-based instructional materials developed in partnership with BSCS Science Learning, an industry leader in inquiry-based instruction for over 65 years, with ongoing professional learning. This model supports educators in refining their instructional practice over time and fosters a strong, collaborative community. Currently, the STEM Learning Institute is implementing a year-long high school introductory chemistry course and professional learning program designed to support teachers and students through relevant, inquiry-driven, and engaging classroom experiences.

Why You’ll Love This Role
We're partnering with leading science educators, school districts, and curriculum experts to create high-quality instructional materials and professional learning that empower teachers and inspire students. As one of the Institute's early team members, you'll have the opportunity to help build a growing national initiative from the ground up. As an essential member of a collaborative team, you’ll have a visible impact every day by helping create the systems, relationships, and experiences that allow educators to focus on what matters most: helping students discover the excitement of science.

If you’re energized by organizing complex projects, solving problems, supporting talented colleagues, and building something meaningful, you’ll find this work both challenging and deeply rewarding.

Position Summary
The Program Coordinator provides operational and administrative support for the STEM Learning Institute. Working closely with the Director, this role ensures that the day-to-day activities of the Institute run efficiently by coordinating projects, supporting educator professional learning, maintaining documentation, managing logistics, and facilitating communication among staff, partners, and participating school district educators and administration.

The Program Coordinator serves as the central point of coordination for the Institute, helping translate strategic priorities into well-organized action plans and ensuring projects move forward on schedule. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Success in this Role Includes:

  • Ensure Effective Program Execution: Coordinate day-to-day program operations so that projects remain organized, major milestones are achieved on schedule, and implementation activities are completed efficiently with minimal oversight.

  • Deliver Exceptional Professional Learning Experiences: Coordinate high-quality virtual and in-person professional learning events by ensuring logistics, participant communications, travel, materials, and technology are organized, resulting in positive experiences for educators and facilitators.

  • Foster Strong Partnerships and Communication: Maintain timely, professional, and responsive communication with participating educators, district leaders, consultants, and external partners, ensuring action items are tracked and follow-up occurs consistently.

  • Maintain Organized Systems and Documentation: Develop and maintain accurate, organized, and accessible project documentation, resources, meeting records, and shared files that support efficient collaboration, informed decision-making, and organizational continuity.

  • Provide Reliable Operational and Financial Support: Support efficient program operations by accurately tracking budgets and expenditures, coordinating stipends and reimbursements, processing purchasing requests, and maintaining complete administrative records.

  • Support Research and Evaluation: Coordinate logistics for research and evaluation activities, including surveys, classroom observations, educator communications, and reporting, ensuring data collection is well-organized, timely, and minimally disruptive to participating educators.

  • Drive Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve processes, increase efficiency, and strengthen collaboration by recommending and implementing practical solutions that enhance the effectiveness of the STEM Learning Institute.


Essential Responsibilities

Program Coordination

  • Coordinate day-to-day operations across curriculum development, professional learning, coaching, implementation, and field testing.

  • Maintain project timelines, implementation schedules, and task management systems.

  • Track milestones and proactively follow up on outstanding deliverables.

  • Identify potential scheduling conflicts or implementation risks and communicate them promptly.

  • Support the Director in implementing strategic initiatives.

Project Management

  • Schedule and coordinate project meetings and agendas.

  • Record meeting notes; track decisions and action items.

  • Monitor deadlines and remind team members of upcoming deliverables.

  • Organize shared files and maintain document version control.

Professional Learning Coordination

  • Coordinate logistics for educator learning experiences including, but not limited to: registration, participant communications, travel, hotel reservations, catering, ground transportation, meeting space, instructional materials printing, shipping, technology, attendance tracking, and evaluations.

  • Support facilitators before, during, and after events.

District Partnerships

  • Serve as an operational contact for participating districts by scheduling meetings, coordinating communications, tracking district needs, maintaining implementation calendars, supporting teacher onboarding, coordinating coaching schedules, and responding to routine questions.

Curriculum Support

Research & Evaluation

  • Coordinate implementation activities related to evaluation, including survey administration, participant communication, consent documentation, scheduling observations, classroom implementation calendars, and data collection logistics.

  • Collaborate closely with the research and evaluation team to reduce the burden on participating educators while maintaining high-quality implementation.

Budget & Administrative Support

  • Maintain accurate program records.

Communications

  • Support internal and external communications through meeting coordination, website content, district updates, presentation preparation, board reports, document formatting, and proofreading.

Systems & Organization

  • Maintain organized systems for project documentation, implementation resources, curriculum files, contracts, district contacts, meeting notes, professional learning materials, and evaluation documentation.

  • Maintain organized documentation using Asana, SharePoint/Google Drive, and other collaboration tools.

  • Organize and file curriculum review documents, meeting notes, implementation guides, and shared resources.

  • Recommend improvements to increase efficiency and consistency across the Institute.

  • Two years of experience in program, project, or office administration or an equivalent combination of education and experience

Preferred:

title: DRG Integrity Analyst - PRN
description:
About Enjoin

At Enjoin, your work makes a meaningful impact. We partner with hospitals and health systems nationwide to improve documentation accuracy, strengthen compliance, and ensure patient care is accurately represented. By combining deep clinical and coding expertise with advanced technology, our team delivers measurable results that support better patient outcomes and appropriate reimbursement.

We're committed to building a collaborative, high-performing culture where people are supported, challenged, and empowered to grow. With more than 200 professionals and a national network of clinical experts, you'll work alongside talented colleagues who value collaboration, innovation, clinical excellence, and a shared commitment to delivering exceptional results.

Proudly Great Place to Work® Certified for three consecutive years, we're dedicated to creating an environment where our people can do their best work while making a real difference.

Job Summary

The DRG Integrity Analyst (DIA) serves as the first level of clinical and coding review for inpatient encounters, focusing on identifying potential DRG opportunities, risks, and documentation gaps. This role performs high-level chart screening to determine whether cases warrant deeper analysis, ensuring only high-value opportunities are advanced for full review.

This position is foundational to driving efficient, high-quality chart review workflows and requires strong knowledge of DRG methodology, clinical indicators, and coding guidelines to support accurate, compliant, and impactful outcomes.

This is a PRN, remote opportunity designed for experienced inpatient coding and CDI professionals seeking flexible, supplemental work. Assignments are offered based on client and business needs, with expectations communicated in advance.

What You'll Do

  • Perform initial screening of inpatient charts to identify DRG optimization opportunities and risks
  • Conduct high-level clinical and coding assessments focused on principal diagnosis, procedures, CC/MCCs, and sequencing
  • Identify documentation gaps, unsupported diagnoses, and coding misalignment impacting DRG assignment
  • Triage and escalate validated opportunities to Clinical Coding Analysts (CCAs) for deeper review
  • Apply standardized screening workflows and DRG methodologies to ensure consistency, accuracy, and productivity

title: Athletic Trainer- South Park
description:
Athletic Trainer- Ballantyne

General Job Summary:

The Athletic Trainer is a licensed healthcare professional who works collaboratively with sports medicine physicians to provide comprehensive musculoskeletal care. This role functions as a clinical extender, supporting injury evaluation, treatment planning, rehabilitation progression, and patient education for athletes and physically active patients across the continuum of care.

The Athletic Trainer helps optimize physician efficiency, improve patient throughput, and enhance the overall patient experience by bridging injury assessment, treatment, and recovery.

Primary Job Responsibilities:

Clinical Care & Patient Management

  • Perform detailed injury histories and musculoskeletal assessments under physician direction

  • Assist physicians with orthopedic and sports medicine physical examinations

  • Translate mechanism of injury, functional demands, and symptom progression into meaningful clinical context

  • Support diagnosis and treatment planning through case presentation and clinical documentation

  • Develop and instruct patients on home exercise programs (HEPs) and injury specific care plans

  • Fit, educate, and manage durable medical equipment (DME), braces, splints, and taping

  • Assist with or perform concussion screening and follow-up per established protocols

  • Monitor rehabilitation progress and communicate patient status to physicians and care teams

Clinic & Physician Support

  • Act as a physician extender to improve clinic flow and efficiency

  • Document patient encounters accurately and timely in the electronic medical record (EMR)

  • Assist with procedures and injections as appropriate and within scope

  • Coordinate care with physical therapy, imaging, and other ancillary services

  • Triage patient questions and messages related to musculoskeletal care

Patient Education & Engagement

  • Educate patients on injury prevention, activity modification, and return to sport/work guidance

  • Reinforce physician treatment plans to promote adherence and positive outcomes

  • Provide clear, age appropriate, and activity specific education to patients and families‑‑specific education to patients and families

Professional Practice

  • Maintain licensure, certification, and continuing education requirements

  • Adhere to evidence-based practice standards and organizational policies

  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and interdisciplinary collaboration

  • Serve as a preceptor for athletic training students when applicable


Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from a CAATE‑accredited athletic training program

  • Board of Certification (BOC) certification as an Athletic Trainer

  • Current NC state licensure

  • Strong knowledge of orthopedic injuries, rehabilitation principles, and sports medicine practices

  • Excellent communication, documentation, and interpersonal skills

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast paced, ‑team based‑ clinical environment

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand, walk, and move throughout the clinic for extended periods

  • Ability to assist patients with positioning, bracing, and therapeutic activities

  • Occasional lifting, bending, and manual assistance as required for patient care

title: Branch Operations Lead - Chaska - Chaska, MN

  • Introduce clients to our friendly branch team, who collaborate to deliver seamless service with care and sincerity. Work together to build lasting relationships and assist with any specialized financial needs, elevating the client experience.

  • You take pride in adhering to policies, procedures, and regulatory banking requirements, ensuring everything runs smoothly and efficiently.

  • You have 6+ months of Associate Banker (Teller) experience.

  • You’ll successfully complete our Branch Operations Lead Training Program before being considered for placement as a Branch Operations Lead.

description:

title: Postdoctoral Clinical Research Scientist
description:
Slingshot AI

Slingshot AI is the team behind Ash, the first AI designed for mental health. Our mission is to make support more accessible and help people change their lives in the ways they want.

We’re building a world-class team by empowering individuals with the autonomy, flexibility, and support they need to do their best work. We dream big, iterate fast, and care deeply. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

Our team spans machine learning, product, engineering, conversational design, clinical, growth, and operations, with offices in both New York City and London.

We're a well-funded Series A company, having raised $93M from Andreessen Horowitz, Radical Ventures, Forerunner Ventures, plus top-tier tech investors involved in ElevenLabs, Captions, Shopify, Plaid, Notion, Canva, Twitch, Airtable, and many others.

The Role

We are hiring a Postdoctoral Clinical Research Scientist to build the evidence base for AI-delivered mental health care. Reporting to the Head of Research, you will design and run the studies that tell us whether Ash is safe, whether it works, and where it needs to get better, then publish what we learn.

This is a fixed-term role of one to two years, based in New York City (hybrid), with potential to convert. If you're interested in pursuing psychology licensure in New York, we'll support you in getting there too.

The field is moving faster than the literature. Your job is to make sure our science stays ahead of it: to invent evaluation methods where none exist yet, to run rigorous studies on a product that ships weekly, and to work shoulder to shoulder with product, engineering, and machine learning so that what you find actually changes what we build.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, run, and analyze clinical studies on AI-based mental health tools: RCTs, observational studies, product-embedded experiments, and HEOR studies assessing cost-effectiveness and healthcare utilization impact.

  • Build and validate novel evaluation methods for conversational AI quality and safety, including LLM-as-judge frameworks for scoring clinical fidelity, empathy, and risk at scale.

  • Lead manuscript preparation for peer-reviewed journals and represent our research at conferences.

  • Collaborate across clinical, product, engineering, legal, and policy to make sure our research is both rigorous and actionable, and that findings reach the people who can act on them.

  • Translate what we learn into sharper measurement: what we track, how we define outcomes, and what evidence we need next.

About you

  • You have a PhD in Clinical Psychology or a related field.

  • You have a strong track record designing and executing clinical research, with solid grounding in methodology, language data analysis, psychometrics, and statistical analysis (R, Python, or similar).

  • You have a publication record in peer-reviewed journals.

  • You're familiar with evidence-based psychotherapy frameworks and clinical outcome measurement.

  • Experience with digital health, telehealth, or AI/ML applications in clinical care is a strong plus.

  • You're a strong communicator who can translate clinical findings for non-clinical audiences without losing the nuance that matters.

  • You're comfortable working fast and iteratively, in a field where the research has to pull ahead of the technology rather than trail behind it.

  • You have genuine conviction about the mission. This work only matters if the people doing it believe it does.

What we offer:

  • A chance to join a passionate tight-knit team working on something to change the world

  • Competitive compensation (top of personal market)

  • Travel between our NYC / London offices

  • Usual startup perks like free lunch and coffee in office + generous learning budget

  • We cover your personal therapy
