title: Design Lead
description:
About Us: Artera is an AI startup that develops medical artificial intelligence tests to personalize therapy for cancer patients. Artera is on a mission to personalize medical decisions for patients and physicians on a global scale.

Artera is seeking a highly strategic and hands-on Design Lead to define and elevate the end-to-end user experience across our products and customer touchpoints. This role is responsible for shaping how clinicians, patients, and partners interact with Artera through our clinic-facing web portals, test reports, medical education and marketing materials.

In this role, you will lead an internal & external team of product designers and partner closely with cross-functional leaders to turn intricate medical data, AI-driven insights, and complex provider workflows into intuitive, accessible, and visually compelling experiences. You will champion cohesive human-centered design principles while meeting the rigorous quality and regulatory standards expected of medical technologies. Your work will help clinicians make more informed decisions, improve patient understanding, and strengthen the overall experience of working with Artera.

Essential Responsibilities:

Design Leadership & Strategy

  • Define the long-term design vision and user experience strategy across Artera’s software products and assets in close alignment with Product, Marketing, Medical, Sales, and Engineering leadership.

  • Scale and govern Artera’s design system, visual standards, component libraries, and Figma file governance to accelerate high-quality design output and engineering execution and ensure a consistent customer experience.

  • Evangelize design thinking across the broader organization, incorporating the voice of the clinical user into product and communication design.

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of product designers, fostering a culture of constructive design critiques, inclusivity, and continuous learning.

    • Clinical UX & Product Delivery

  • Translate highly complex workflows—such as medical imaging, data-heavy analytics, and/or AI-assisted decision making—into clear interaction graphics and visuals.

  • Own the end-to-end design lifecycle, producing user flows, low-fidelity wireframes, interactive prototypes, and production-ready high-fidelity UI specifications.

  • Ensure data clarity and information architecture, ensuring critical health data is contextualized safely to prevent clinician cognitive overload and medical error.

    • Product Marketing & Brand Alignment

  • Oversee product launch design, creating compelling marketing assets, landing pages, interactive product demos, and visual sales enablement collateral.

  • Translate the product’s clinical value into marketing visuals, converting scientific, high-density health data and outcomes research into clear, impactful infographics, case studies, and presentation decks.

  • Maintain brand consistency, ensuring the visual language used across sales pitches, marketing campaigns, and website touchpoints aligns perfectly with the core product software experience

    • Education and Experience Requirements:

  • Minimum of 8 years of digital product design experience, with at least 2+ years leading or mentoring design teams.

  • Proven track record in healthcare or regulated spaces (e.g., HealthTech, SaMD, BioTech, clinical trial software, or complex enterprise B2B SaaS)

  • A robust portfolio demonstrating complex system design, deep user research integration, data visualization, and successful cross-functional product launches.

  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives, with demonstrable ability to achieve results, hold vendors accountable, and manage shifting priorities.

  • Experience driving commercial success at fast-growth startups, with rapidly evolving products in a competitive landscape.

  • Expert proficiency with design tools, such as Figma, Canva, and Adobe Creative Suites

  • Cultural Fit

  • Tight alignment with Artera’s values of Patient Success, Impact, Perseverance, Team Synergy, and Efficiency.

  • Capable of operating in a lean and cost-efficient way.

  • Results-oriented mindset, with a passion for driving fast and sustainable growth and delivering value to customers.

About the Opportunity
Reporting to the Human Resources team, the Human Resources Coordinator plays an integral role in supporting the day-to-day operations of HR while helping deliver an exceptional employee experience across our Canadian and U.S. workforce.
This role is ideal for someone early in their HR career who enjoys balancing administration with employee support, data analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives. You'll partner closely with leaders and employees across the organization, helping ensure our people programs are delivered accurately, efficiently, and with a people-first mindset.
From onboarding new employees and administering HR programs to maintaining employee records, supporting compliance, and contributing to culture initiatives, you'll play an important role in helping Kensington continue to attract, engage, and retain exceptional talent.

  • Identify opportunities to improve HR programs, processes, and employee experiences through continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Monitor trends and proactively identify opportunities to strengthen employee engagement, retention, morale, and overall organizational effectiveness.
  • Prepare HR reports, dashboards, workforce metrics, and data analysis to support leadership decision-making and workforce planning.
  • Develop job aids, process documentation, and training materials to support employees using ADP and other HR systems.
  • Support internal and external HR audits while ensuring the integrity, confidentiality, and accuracy of employee data.
  • Contribute to additional HR projects and initiatives as assigned.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, including reporting, data analysis, and dashboard creation.
  • Experience supporting HRIS platforms or similar HR technologies, ADP experience is an asset.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with employees and leaders across multiple functions.
  • Excellent organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret HR data and identify meaningful insights.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with confidence interacting across all levels of the organization.
  • High degree of professionalism, discretion, and integrity when handling confidential information.

title: Clinical Informaticists II
description:
Founded in early 2021, Ibility is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business and a Woman-Owned Small Business, headquartered in Gaithersburg, MD. Ibility is a small but mighty company that is positioned for rapid growth. Simply put, we help government leaders to achieve their mission by designing creative products and programs that delight their customers and make their employees more efficient - building trust and improving overall satisfaction. We use human-centered design principles in every engagement because we believe the end-user is critical to the long-term success of any solution. Our team is fun, passionate, bold, and creative. We live our mission every day – to inspire people, create cool stuff, and make a lasting impact on the world!

Position Overview:

The Clinical Informaticist II supports the effective management and optimization of enterprise health information systems through data governance, analytics, interoperability, and operational performance initiatives. Working collaboratively with clinical, technical, and operational stakeholders, this role analyzes clinical and operational data, evaluates system performance, and supports workflow optimization, data integrity, and reporting activities that enhance the reliability and effective use of healthcare information. The Clinical Informaticist II contributes to enterprise informatics initiatives by promoting standardized data management practices, improving information quality, and supporting data-driven operational decision-making.

Please note this position is contingent upon award (Aug/Sept 2026)

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support workflow stabilization and optimization by evaluating clinical workflows, analyzing user and operational needs, and recommending process improvements that enhance efficiency, usability, and quality of care.
  • Perform data quality management, data governance, and data integrity activities by validating clinical information, identifying data discrepancies, supporting governance initiatives, and promoting accurate, consistent, and reliable healthcare data.
  • Support reporting and analytics by analyzing clinical and operational data, developing reports and dashboards, and providing actionable insights that support operational decision-making and continuous performance improvement.
  • Monitor operational metrics and rapid intervention activities by evaluating key performance indicators, identifying emerging trends or risks, and collaborating with stakeholders to support timely issue resolution and operational stability.
  • Support interoperability, archiving, and data retention management activities by assisting with healthcare data exchange, information lifecycle management, and compliance with organizational policies, regulatory requirements, and informatics best practices.

Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Clinical Informatics, Health Informatics, Nursing Informatics, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible experience supporting clinical informatics, healthcare information systems, electronic health records (EHRs), or digital health initiatives.
  • Experience supporting data quality management, data governance, clinical reporting, and healthcare analytics.
  • Experience analyzing and optimizing clinical workflows within healthcare environments.
  • Experience supporting enterprise Electronic Health Record (EHR) implementation, optimization, or sustainment activities.
  • Knowledge of healthcare interoperability principles, clinical data standards, and information management best practices.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to translate technical information into actionable recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting Oracle Health (Cerner), Epic, or other enterprise EHR platforms.
  • Experience supporting the Veterans Health Administration (VHA), Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Department of Defense (DoD), or other federal healthcare organizations.
  • Familiarity with HL7, FHIR, SNOMED CT, LOINC, ICD-10, or other healthcare interoperability and terminology standards.
  • Experience developing dashboards, operational reports, or healthcare performance metrics.
  • Relevant certifications such as CPHIMS, AMIA Clinical Informatics, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or comparable healthcare informatics certifications.

Benefits:

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Plans
  • Short Term Disability / Long Term Disability / Life Insurance / Accidental Death and Dismemberment
  • Health Savings Account
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off
  • 11 Federal Holidays Off
  • 401k

title: Lead Creator, Brand Social
description:
Ladder is hiring the face and voice of the world's best fitness app. Not a spokesperson reading someone else's script — a creator with a real point of view, a body of work that proves it, and the presence to hold an audience's attention.

You will be the personality our audience follows. The work is to make strength training genuinely compelling: to take real programming knowledge and turn it into content people watch twice and send to someone else. You'll concept it, shoot it, edit it, and publish it, sometimes in the same day. You’ll also be on set with coaches, helping them with their content, sharing the screen in the BTS, interviewing and talking with them too. Think TV-host for the gen-z social generation.

We want to be clear about the trade. Most creators are building their own brand. This role is not that. Your creative output belongs to Ladder — our channels, our audience, our budget, our coaches, our celebrity partners. You'll have resources and reach that independent creators rarely get access to, and a team invested in making your work better. In return, we need your full focus. If you're looking for a role that supports a personal channel or leaves room for other brand partnerships, this isn't the right fit.

Report to: VP, Brand & Creative

What You'll Do:

  • Serve as the recurring on-camera face of Ladder across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube

  • Own content end to end — concept, shoot, edit, publish — at the pace the platforms require

  • Build and star in repeatable series that give an audience a reason to return, rather than one-off posts that disappear

  • Translate real fitness expertise into content that holds attention: make progressive overload, program design, and training psychology land with people who have never encountered those ideas

  • Create alongside our coaches and celebrity partners, and draw the best possible performance out of them on camera

  • Read performance data closely and let it shape what you make next

  • Partner with our Senior Manager, Brand Social and the wider creative team on the direction of the channel

Requirements

  • Located in Austin, TX

  • A real body of work — an audience you built yourself, with content you personally appeared in, wrote, shot, and edited

  • On-camera presence that reads as a person, not a presenter. Articulate, genuinely funny, and comfortable carrying a piece on your own

  • Expert-level iPhone production and CapCut editing. You can take an idea to a finished cut without a crew or a post house

  • Deep, hands-on fitness knowledge with genuine strength training experience — you can speak credibly about programming because you have actually done it

  • A sharp instinct for cultural trends and for how formats differ across platforms

  • Willingness to be Ladder's creator exclusively. This is a full-time commitment to our brand, not a salary layered beneath a personal brand or competing partnerships

  • A collaborative, no-ego approach to feedback and iteration

Why Ladder

We’re building the world’s best fitness business. We are a small team of no-ego experts that think in first-principles. We don’t follow the lead of our competitors, we lead the industry with our innovation, and you’ll be a major part of shaping that innovation to keep Ladder at the forefront of fitness and culture!

Our creative team is insanely talented, producing the best creative in fitness, all while doing bits and having fun. We are the hardest working and most fun team in the industry.

If you’re an A+ player that brings your absolute best, that thrives taking big swings and executing at a high-level, this is the place for you. This is not a role where you will be micromanaged - we expect you to be the best and have the freedom and resources to be creative and make great work!

ABOUT LADDER

Ladder Benefits

  • The best team in fitness

  • Access to the sickest private gym in Austin

  • Incredible marketing campaigns with the world’s most expert coaches, and top celebrities, alike

  • Equity in Ladder

  • Access to Company Insurance (Health, Dental, Vision)

  • Company-wide events

  • Unlimited PTO

  • New Company Computer

  • Free Ladder membership, Ladder swag, etc.!

title: Card Risk Portfolio Analytics – Associate
description:
Bring your expertise to JPMorgan Chase. As part of our Risk Management and Compliance team, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks and using your expert judgment to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo and striving to be best-in-class.

This role requires deep curiosity, strong analytical skills, collaboration, and attention to detail.

Job Responsibilities

  • Apply current AI capabilities to analyze the Card portfolio and uncover meaningful patterns and insights.

  • Identify and size new and emerging credit risks, recommending actions to risk colleagues within Card acquisition and portfolio management.

  • Evaluate new data sources and to improve card risk management.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • Knowledge of financial procedures and principles, with a strong understanding of consumer banking.

  • Experience with SAS, Python, Tableau, and/or Alteryx, LLM tools.

title: Strategy Senior Associate - AI Journey Transformation
description:
Join the Artificial Intelligence (AI) Journey Transformation team to accelerate and scale AI solutions that work and shape omni-channel customer experiences. The team combines digital strategy, AI transformation, and analytics to accelerate smarter, more seamless customer journeys. This role provides an exciting opportunity to support senior leadership across the firm on a portfolio of high-priority strategic initiatives.

As a Strategy Senior Analyst on the AI Journey Transformation team, you will support a portfolio of firm-wide strategic initiatives through rigorous analysis, structured problem solving, and clear executive-ready communication. You will collaborate with partners across digital, operations, product, analytics, and business teams to help identify opportunities, size impact, develop business cases, and support go-to-market and operating model planning. Success in this role requires a passion for AI solutions and customer experience, strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills, and the ability to translate complex data and processes into actionable insights. Projects are typically team-based and include close collaboration with senior stakeholders across the firm on a wide variety of initiatives, including: assessing opportunities to drive digital and AI transformation in customer servicing journeys, supporting journey optimization and reimagination, evaluating strategic digital and AI investments, and contributing to operating model design.

﻿

Job Responsibilities

  • Support initiatives/projects to address diverse problems identified by senior leaders; help drive workstreams to completion with strong attention to detail
  • Partner with cross-functional teams in digital, product, business, analytics, and operations to gather inputs, align on requirements, and synthesize findings
  • Conduct journey assessments by mapping current-state processes, identifying pain points/friction, and helping define future-state improvements
  • Apply structured problem-solving and design thinking to break down ambiguous problems into hypotheses, analyses, and decision-ready recommendations
  • Gather, synthesize, analyze, and present data and findings, including financial/business case modeling, impact sizing, and KPI frameworks
  • Execute analyses to support integration of digital solutions with CCB Operations to enhance customer journeys and reduce friction
  • Perform competitor/industry research leveraging public sources (and internal sources where appropriate) to inform strategy and recommendations
  • Develop strategic presentations and supporting materials for internal stakeholder reviews and leadership readouts
  • Monitor industry and technology trends (including AI) and share concise insights with the broader team
  • Support team execution by maintaining workplans, tracking decisions/risks, and coordinating inputs across partners

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • 2+ years of relevant experience in strategy, consulting, banking/finance, analytics, product strategy, or an internal corporate strategy/strategic initiatives function
  • Exposure to consumer banking and/or business banking concepts, customer journeys, or operations (through work experience, internships, or project work)
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze problems and apply quantitative approaches (e.g., impact sizing, Return on Investment/business case analysis, scenario analysis)
  • Strong communication skills (written and verbal) with the ability to translate analysis into clear takeaways for stakeholders
  • Strong collaboration skills and comfort working in cross-functional teams
  • Strong presentation development skills (PowerPoint) and analytical tooling skills (Excel)
  • High attention to detail, strong ownership mindset, and ability to manage priorities in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • Exposure to digital product, process improvement/journey optimization, and/or AI transformation (academic, internship, or professional)
  • Financial services industry experience
  • Consumer and Community Banking / Global Banking experience
  • Familiarity with analytics concepts (KPIs, experimentation, funnel/journey metrics)
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; advanced degree a plus

title: Center Administrator
description:
Position Summary

The Center Administrator is an entry level operations role that establishes the foundation for future growth within the organization. This role is responsible for the overall operational functions within the center. Duties include cleanliness, maintenance, and facilities needs; ordering and managing supplies for the center; and assisting team members in the center as needed. Individuals in this role will need to provide excellent customer service by consistently demonstrating a professional disposition with all customer and team member relations over the phone and during day-to-day center operations.

Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Day-to-Day Administrative Support
    • Center Administrative Support
      • Open/close center when needed.
      • Greet new and existing clients and other visitors to the center and give tours when necessary.
      • Complete any related administrative tasks such as providing printed materials, etc.
      • Work with Operations Director to maintain center supply inventory and ensure staff has the required items to operate.
      • Ensure the center is clean, attractive, and safe for team members and clients, and report to others as needed.
      • Keep furniture and therapy equipment in good working condition and arrange for repairs and maintenance as needed.
      • Maintain records to ensure compliance with local, state, and federal mandates.
      • Receive deliveries, as needed.

    • Partner with Operations Director to ensure client and Behavior Technicians schedules are maintained and up to date in Centria EMR system.
    • Be a go-to person for general center-related questions. Able to either answer their questions or connect them with someone who can.
    • Ensure state and Centria guidelines and policies are followed, and incidents documented and escalated to the appropriate parties as necessary.
  3. Maintain compliance and acquire technical knowledge by completing required training and attending meetings. Adhere to Centria's established policies and procedures.
  4. Participate in an agency-wide Compliance Program to ensure services are consistent with the individual's authorized services.
  5. Follow guidelines, i.e., mandated reporting, compliance, and company guidelines.
  6. Compliance with Centria’s Code of Conduct, policies and procedures, and Federal and State laws.

$22 -24.00

Qualifications

Education

High School Diploma or equivalent, minimum requirement

Work Experience

Previous experience in a customer service role

Attend training and other company in-services and training as directed by the direct leader and compliance teams.

  • Laptop

  • ABA Platforms, preferred

Other Competency Requirements

  • Ability to use computers and computer/software programs

Knowledge and Skills

  • Proficiency in PC software, including virtual meeting platforms;
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to do repetitive things in a precise manner with attention to detail and quality;
  • Ability to interpret and implement verbal and written clinical protocols;
  • Ability to accept constructive feedback and develop expertise and skillsets accordingly;
  • Effective time management skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks at once;
  • Ability to build and maintain professional relationships with clients, co-workers, supervisors, and community members;
  • Ability to adhere to organizational policies and procedures
  • Commitment to maintain client confidentiality and adhere to HIPAA laws;

title: Program Manager, GTM Strategic Initiatives
description:
Position Summary

DDN is seeking a Program Manager to drive execution for key GTM Strategic Initiatives. This role serves as a connective partner across Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance, Partnerships, and Post Sales, working to turn high level strategies into robust plans of action and well-run programs. This is a role for someone who is an orchestrator and loves to put structure behind complex scenarios.

What This Role Is Here to Do

You will put the operational rigor and tools in place to facilitate DDN’s growth at scale. That means building the frameworks, measurements, and governance structures to drive seamless execution and continued alignment.

You will partner with GTM leaders and cross-functional teams to structure how strategic priorities are planned, tracked, and delivered. You will own the program management work required to keep initiatives moving and visible across the company.

What Success Looks Like

DDN's strategic initiatives move forward with clear owners, clear milestones, and no ambiguity about status. Leaders are aligned on prioritization and know where things stand including: what's on track, what's at risk, and what decision is needed to unblock it. Decisions are made through data-driven assessment and progress is actively tracked to inform where intervention may be needed.

The Work You'll Lead

  • Build and manage trusted relationships with stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance, Partnerships, and Post Sales

  • Translate high-level strategy into structured plans with clear owners and milestones

  • Establish and run the operating cadence for strategic planning, including KPI development, tracking, and reporting

  • Own execution of select initiatives among DDN's top 5-10 strategic priorities, managing milestones, dependencies, and risks

  • Build the program plans, governance structures, and communication cadences that keep cross-functional initiatives on track

  • Drive change management for major initiatives, building stakeholder buy-in, communication plans, and adoption tracking so that new plans and priorities stick

  • Support structured analysis on new market expansion and partnership opportunities to inform leadership decisions

  • Stay close to the business and bring back what you learn: where initiatives are stuck, where models need updating, what leadership needs to know next

What You Bring

  • 3-5 years of experience in program management, GTM operations, strategy, or management consulting, ideally in a B2B tech or infrastructure company

  • A track record of building operational structure around complex, ambiguous initiatives

  • Experience building growth or investment models and translating data into recommendations

  • Comfort diagnosing and structuring ambiguous problems: you proactivately create clarity and process where none currently exists

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple workstreams across stakeholders and functions

  • Strong communication skills; comfortable working with stakeholders across levels and driving alignment without formal authority

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment, adjusting priorities as business needs shift

  • Exposure to M&A, partnerships, or new market entry a plus

We Build Together

We're a team that shows up for each other and for the business. We share what we know, ask good questions, and celebrate wins, big and small. DDN is building something real, and so are we.

title: Director, Implementation
description:
About Waymark

Waymark is a team of healthcare providers, technologists, and builders whose mission is to bring the best healthcare to people with Medicaid benefits. Guided by the communities we serve, we bring support and technology-enabled care to help primary care providers keep Medicaid patients healthy. We are building the tools and designing an approach to enable care to reach the patients who can benefit most.

Our core values embody the essence of what makes Waymark a unique team today, and what we look for, nurture, and sustain as a team.

  • We are bold builders, believing that the greatest challenges in care delivery can be solved when we harness the power of community and technology.
  • We are humble learners, seeking feedback and perspectives different from our own, and welcome challenges to our conclusions.
  • We experiment to improve, actively seeking data to inform decisions and to assess our own performance.
  • We act with focused urgency, our commitment to our mission drives us to tirelessly pursue results.

If this vision resonates with you, we hope you consider bringing your creativity, your energy, your curiosity to Waymark.

About this Role

The Director of Implementation serves as the senior operational leader responsible for the end-to-end planning and delivery of Waymark implementations including new geographies, managed care organization (MCO) contract launches, and provider group contract launches. Reporting to the Head of Operations, this leader is accountable for the implementation function, ensuring implementations are delivered on time, in scope, and to a consistently high standard through direct contribution and team management.

This is a hands-on program leadership role for a seasoned project management professional. You will own, build, and run the implementation function's core infrastructure — project plans, workplans, governance structures, status reporting, risk and issue management, and repeatable playbooks — while personally leading the most complex, high-stakes launches. You and your team will be the connective tissue between Waymark's internal teams (clinical, product, engineering, analytics, quality, compliance, and regional market leadership) and our external partners (MCOs, provider groups), managing stakeholders at every level from working teams to executives. This role is a unique opportunity to build and scale the implementation function from the ground up, allowing you to define the strategic and operational roadmap and evolve the team as Waymark grows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implementation Project Planning & Delivery
    • Own end-to-end delivery of large, complex, multi-workstream implementations — new market expansions and MCO and provider contract launches — from kickoff through stabilization and handoff to ongoing operations.
    • Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, including detailed workplans, milestone schedules, resource plans, dependency maps, and critical path analyses for each implementation.
    • Establish and run implementation governance: project charters, RACI/decision-rights frameworks, working group cadences, executive status reporting, and stage-gate reviews.
    • Proactively identify, track, and mitigate risks, issues, and dependencies; drive timely escalation and resolution to keep implementations on schedule and in scope.
    • Manage scope, timeline, and budget across concurrent implementations, making clear trade-off recommendations to leadership when priorities conflict.
    • Lead post-launch retrospectives and translate lessons learned into improved processes, tools, and playbooks.
  • External Stakeholder Management
    • Serve as the senior implementation point of contact for MCO and provider partners — leading presentations and joint implementation meetings with clients and prospective clients, aligning on delivery timelines and data exchange requirements, and managing executive-level communications and escalations.
    • Guide MCO and provider partners through onboarding, workflow integration, and adoption of Waymark's care model and technology.
    • Build durable, trust-based relationships with external partners that position Waymark for contract expansion and long-term partnership success.
  • Internal Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Leadership
    • Orchestrate cross-functional implementation teams spanning clinical, product, engineering, analytics, quality, compliance, regional market leadership, partnerships, and finance — driving alignment on scope, sequencing, and accountability without direct authority.
    • Partner with Regional VPs and market leaders to translate contract requirements into executable local launch plans, balancing standardization with market-level flexibility.
    • Partner with product and analytics teams to plan and sequence Signal and other data product deployments and facilitate adoption by care teams.
    • Champion internal stakeholder alignment, bringing teams along through transparent, proactive communication regarding implementation roadmaps, trade-offs, and fluid deliverables to foster full cross-departmental buy-in.
    • Provide clear, concise, and candid status reporting to executive leadership, including progress against milestones, risks, and decisions needed.
  • Implementation Infrastructure & Team Leadership
    • Build the implementation function's core toolkit: standardized playbooks, templates, launch checklists, success metrics, and operating rhythms that make implementations repeatable, transparent, and scalable.
    • Define and track implementation KPIs (time-to-launch, milestone attainment, partner satisfaction) and use them to drive continuous improvement.
    • Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing implementation team; develop project management capability across the broader organization.
    • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 7+ years in healthcare services implementation, program management, or operations — ideally in tech-enabled care delivery or value-based care — with a track record of leading large, complex, multi-stakeholder implementations from planning through launch.
  • Project & Program Management: Deep expertise in formal project management disciplines — workplan development, milestone and dependency management, risk/issue tracking, governance, and status reporting — with demonstrated success delivering complex programs on time and in scope.
  • External Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to manage relationships with health plans, provider groups, and other external partners at all levels, including executive sponsors; skilled at navigating competing priorities, negotiating timelines, and managing escalations.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Demonstrated success leading matrixed, cross-functional teams in fast-paced environments, driving alignment and accountability without direct authority.
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex programs into clear, decision-ready updates for executives and external partners.
  • Data & Technology: Experience implementing or deploying technology platforms and using data to guide operational decisions; fluency with project management tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Passion for improving care for Medicaid patients.
  • Experience with Medicaid managed care, including MCO contracting and data exchange.
  • Experience launching new markets, contracts, or service lines in early-stage, high-growth environments.
  • Formal project management certification (PMP or Lean Six Sigma).
  • Track record of building implementation functions, playbooks, and teams from the ground up, with a focus on individual development.

Hiring Range

US Employees in San Francisco/Bay Area, New York City - $160,000 - $229,000

US Employees in Boston, Los Angeles, Seattle, Washington DC - $147,000 - $211,000

US Employees in Arlington, Denver, San Diego, Sacramento - $141,000 - $201,000

US Employees in Albany, Atlanta, Austin, Baltimore, Central/Southern, Charlotte, Chicago, Dallas/Fort Worth, Detroit, Houston, Las Vegas, Miami, Milwaukee, Philadelphia, Portland, Research Triangle, Salt Lake City, Twin Cities - $128,000 - $183,000

US Employees in Baton Rouge, Birmingham, Charleston, Cincinnati, Cleveland, Daytona Beach, Indianapolis, Nashville, New Orleans, Omaha, Phoenix, Pittsburgh, St. Louis, Tampa - $124,000 - $177,000

In addition to salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package. Here’s what you can expect:

Stock Options: Opportunity to invest in the company’s growth.

Work-from-Home Stipend: A dedicated stipend for your first year to help set up your home office.

Medical, Vision, and Dental Coverage: Comprehensive plans to keep you and your family healthy.

Life Insurance: Basic life insurance to give you peace of mind.

Paid Time Off: 20 vacation days, accrued over the year, plus 11 paid holidays.

Parental Leave: 16 weeks of paid leave for birthing parents after six months of employment, and 8 weeks of bonding leave for non-birthing parents.

Retirement Savings: Access to a 401(k) plan with a company contribution, subject to a vesting schedule.

Commuter Benefits: Convenient options to support your commute needs.

Professional Development Stipend: A dedicated stipend supports professional development and growth.

Offer of employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Employment history and advance degree verification (when applicable) are included as part of the standard background check process.

Don’t check off every box in the requirements listed above? Please apply anyway! Studies have shown that some of us may be less likely to apply to jobs unless we meet every single qualification. Waymark is dedicated to building a supportive, equal opportunity, and accessible workplace that fosters a sense of belonging – so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every preferred qualification in the job description, we encourage you to still consider submitting an application. You may be just the right candidate for this role or another one of our openings!

title: Institutional Investor Engagement Consultant
description:
Investor Relations at Private Equity Insights

This role offers you the opportunity to expand and nurture our community of key VIP groups such as institutional investors (LPs) and other key stakeholders in the Private Equity Industry.
Do you want to take part in defining the future of Private Equity? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about people and building relationships? If so, you might be our next member of the investor relations team.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 500k followers on LinkedIn organising a series of 12 global private equity events every year with 2,000+ GPs, 1,000+ LPs among the attendees.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media () which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

You get the unique opportunity to take ownership of one of our key business areas. You’ll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never-ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • The opportunity of having a real impact - You’ll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.
  • Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company.
  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.
  • Travel opportunity: You would be joining our conferences overseas.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.

Your Responsibilities

Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:

  • Identify, maintain and develop long-standing and fruitful relationships with institutional investors who can benefit from the targeted offering of our product and network
  • Accommodate the investment strategy of the LP by facilitating 1:1 meetings with relevant fund managers
  • Support the team to fulfil delivery of our exclusive products such as roundtables, panel sessions, and VIP receptions. This may sometimes require securing an audience that extends beyond our usual definition of institutional investors, such as GPs

What the future hold for you with our company

Whether you are with or for 2 or 10+ years we believe this position to lay the foundation for a very successful career. We are strong believers of internal promotions and aim to land all management positions internally, and with 45% of our people exiting to PE/Venture or M&A it emphasizes the opportunity arising from this company.

What we expect from you

Please note that this job does not require any specific previous work experience as training is provided and we are looking to incorporate candidates across different levels of experience. However, we do require you to have a UK work permit.

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:

  • Have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what they do;
  • Possess and unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency;
  • Take ownership of everything they do, are proactive and follow through on commitments;
  • Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations;
  • Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;
  • Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.

Start date

Flexible

The role is onsite, Monday to Friday, based in our offices at Sloane Square. It is essential we work at a fast pace and collaborate in person to create market-leading, unmatched events throughout the calendar year. It will be great to have you as part of our team.

title: Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer
description:
Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going
Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries.
Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security.
With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity.
If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you!

Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to design, develop, test, and maintain firmware for embedded systems built around modern microcontrollers. This role is primarily focused on low-level embedded firmware development, but also includes host-side tooling, CI pipeline support, hardware bring-up, and debugging across the hardware/software boundary.

The ideal candidate is a strong C developer with deep embedded systems experience, practical hardware debugging skills, and the ability to work comfortably from schematic review through firmware implementation, automated testing, and production support.

NOTE: Candidate must reside in The United States or Canada.

What You'll Do

  • Design, implement, test, and maintain embedded firmware for ARM Cortex-M microcontroller-based systems, including low-level drivers, board support packages, application firmware, and debugging workflows.
  • Debug firmware and hardware issues using SWD/JTAG, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, and other lab equipment.
  • Develop Python-based host tools for device control, diagnostics, manufacturing test, automation, and data collection.
  • Bring up hardware, automated testing setups, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Debug and resolve lab, manufacturing, and field issues.
  • Participate in architecture development, design/code reviews, and doc writing.

    • What We're Looking For

  • Strong professional experience developing embedded firmware in C for microcontroller-based systems, particularly ARM Cortex-M devices.
  • Proficiency with Python for host-side tooling, automation, diagnostics, testing, or firmware update workflows.
  • Comfortable working in a Linux development environment, including command-line tools, build systems, device interfaces, and debugging workflows.
  • Proficiency with git, multi-repository workflows, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Comfort at the hardware/software boundary (reading schematics, using lab equipment, and debugging integration issues.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills, including clear text-based communication for a remote workforce.
  • At least five years experience in a similar role, along with a background in EE, CS, or related technical field.

    • Nice To Have

  • Prior work with embedded protocols, especially USB, USB-PD, UART, I2C, and SPI.
  • Experience developing USB device firmware (descriptors, enumeration, CDC, DFU, HID, or vendor-specific interfaces).
  • Experience with hardware-in-the-loop testing, manufacturing test systems, or production diagnostics.
  • Experience with CMake, Make, GCC/Clang, linker scripts, static analysis, unit testing, integration testing, or pytest.
  • Prior experience with Raspberry Pi RP2040 and RP2350 MCUs.

    • Compensation & Benefits

    The Compensation range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. Please note that the actual compensation may vary depending on location and job-related factors such as qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. If you are applying for this role outside of the primary location and you are selected for an interview, the Talent Acquisition Partner can share more information with you. If the compensation structure for the role includes an incentive component (i.e. most Sales roles) the range below represents total target compensation (TTC) (base salary + variable).

    $150,000 - $200,000 (USD) a year
    $130,000 - $180,000 (CAD) a year
    Salary range (min - max)

    Position Type: New Vacancy

    Magnet is proud to offer benefits such as:
    - Generous time off policies
    - Competitive compensation
    - Volunteer opportunities
    - Reward and recognition programs
    - Employee committees & resource groups
    - Healthcare and retirement benefits
    Indicators of Success
    We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”. It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have “been there, done that”. We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us.
    How We Work
    At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals.
    We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best!
    The Most Important Thing
    We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences:
    CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world.
    OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect.
    DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect.
    EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work.
    Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways.
    Magnet Forensics is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment process and work environment. Accommodation is available to all applicants upon request throughout the hiring process. Please contact aoda@magnetforensics.com should you require any accommodations.
    All offers of employment at Magnet are contingent upon satisfactory completion of a background check. All background checks will be conducted in accordance with all applicable laws. Magnet will consider each position’s job duties, among other factors, in determining what constitutes satisfactory completion of the background check. Refusal to consent to a background check may be grounds for revoking an offer of employment.

title: Renewable & Distributed Energy Resource (DER) Project Manager
description:
Renewable & Distributed Energy Resource (DER) Project Manager

SCS System Planning – Generation Planning & Development Dept

WORK LOCATION:

  • This position will be based out of Birmingham, AL or Atlanta, GA, however candidates living outside of the area may be considered with the expectation that they could successfully telework and would be willing to travel to work and/or field location on a routine (to be determined) and as-needed basis.
  • This position will require a mix of both field and office work.
  • Some office work can be performed remotely (telework/work from home).

JOB SUMMARY

This position serves as the Renewable and Distributed Energy Resource (DER) development manager with formal leadership and supervisory responsibilities that include but are not limited to:

  • Develop strategic approach for the evaluation, development, and deployment of renewable resources for the Retail Electric Operating companies of Southern Company.

  • Develop strategic approach for the evaluation, development, and deployment of Distributed Energy Resources (DER) for the Retail Electric Operating companies of Southern Company.

  • Support project development teams with project leadership as needed for either traditional or non-traditional inverter or inertia-based projects

  • Lead the system Technology Application Standards (TAS) development as well as the Technology Strategy Coordination (TSC) associated with what the cost, performance and commercial availability for emerging technologies may be

  • Provide performance management and leadership for the employees within the team.

  • Support regulatory filing requirements for asset certifications

JOB QUALIFICATIONS

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree is required

  • Advanced degree is desired

  • An MBA and experience in power generation a plus

Experience, Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:

  • Desired experience in the areas of generation development, project management, project development, economic evaluations, and state or federal regulatory environment

  • Desired areas of knowledge include: life cycle cost analysis; avoided and marginal cost concepts; economic dispatch; Southern Company integrated resource planning process; generation and transmission planning processes; generation technologies and operation; federal and or legislation and rules governing renewable energy; typical power purchase agreement terms and conditions

  • High degree of critical/strategic thinking to resolve high impact, complex and/or cross-functional problems. Ability to communicate complex issues in a clear and understandable manner to a broad group of stakeholders

  • Demonstrated effective leadership, communication and interpersonal skills

  • Must be able to lead the activities of numerous direct and indirect reports and achieve business results in a cost effective and timely manner

  • Demonstrated ability to work in a dynamic and changing environment where goals and objectives may not always be clearly established or defined

SPECIFIC JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide strategic leadership and direction to evaluate the deployment of cost effective and reliably sufficient renewable resources into the Southern Company generation portfolio.

  • Provide strategic leadership and direction to evaluate the deployment of cost effective and reliably sufficient distributed energy resources into the Southern Company generation portfolio.

  • Develop strategies to maximize the value of renewable generation and distributed energy resources through their efficient integration across the Southern Company energy system​.

  • Develop and deploy economical renewable solutions through evaluation of resource viability within the system footprint, customer and stakeholder engagement, process integration and alignment, technology innovation, and policy influence.

  • Lead efforts to develop operating company specific renewable generation project strategy and create robust, and economically sound evaluation techniques for continued integration of DERs and expansion of incremental DER technologies into business activities.

  • Lead efforts to ensure operating company owned renewable projects required to meet regulatory filings meet all regulatory standards for quality, compliance and expertise.

  • Lead efforts to assure that the team builds and maintains positive relationships with key internal and external parties to facilitate broad knowledge of development approaches and resource integration.

  • Lead efforts to engage external OEM’s to understand emerging issues with renewable and DER technologies such that optimal deployment can be ensured.

  • Provide cross-organizational support for developing projects as availability and business needs may require

  • Lead a staff and budget with a focus on prioritizing future expenditures in areas of value and benefit to the company

  • Ensure Southern style is exemplified through the team and in all interactions with internal and external customers, colleagues, and business contacts

  • Lead the technology portfolio management process for renewable and DER technologies, screening based on qualitative and quantitative criteria, and the establishment of technology application standards

  • Develop, maintain, and revise standards of renewable and DER technology attributes for all commercial evaluations and IRP uses that includes capital cost, O&M costs, typical performance metrics, general site requirements, system limitations, and flexibility

  • Lead enterprise-wide project teams to investigate, evaluate, and recommend state-of-the-art deployment structures for renewable and DER energy supply technologies including customer sited applications

  • Support the development of comparative economic analyses (e.g. levelized cost of energy, levelized cost of capacity) of renewable and DER technologies relevant to the retail OPCOs

  • Inform System Planning’s methods for accurately modeling renewable and DER generation technologies

  • Maintain current working knowledge of industry trends and published technology assessments and forecasts from entities such as S&P Global, BNEF, NREL, NETL, EIA, Lazard, and public disclosures from other utilities

  • Develop new renewable and DER solution constructs for the Retail Operating companies

Additional Details:

The position works directly with other managers within System Planning and across the Planning and operating organizations of the retail electric operating companies and must be an excellent communicator. The successful candidate must be comfortable with public speaking and must be capable of positively representing and defending the company against adversarial parties, in a diplomatic manner.

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

  • This position can require some travel – approximately 25% per year.

RELOCATION

  • Some relocation assistance is available if the selected candidate currently resides outside the Birmingham area

BEHAVIORAL ATTRIBUTES

  • Demonstrate Southern Company Values – Safety First, Unquestionable Trust, Superior Performance, and Total Commitment
  • Safety focus and a strong personal safety record

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Data, ML & AI)
description:
Forward Deployed Engineer (Data, ML & AI)

Location: Remote Timezone: NA/Eastern Type: Full-time Experience: 10+ Years



Role Overview

This position requires a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) specializing in Data, Machine Learning, and AI to embed directly within customer environments. You will serve as the primary technical authority transforming complex data challenges and operational bottlenecks into production-grade data pipelines, machine learning systems, and agentic AI solutions.

The role is heavily customer-facing: you will work alongside client business units and engineering teams to rapidly assess legacy data estates, build scalable modern data platforms, and deploy custom GenAI/LLM workflows that drive measurable business velocity. This is a high-ownership, hands-on role where you will leverage Spec-Driven Development (SDD) and AI-assisted workflows to build, refactor, and demonstrate immediate value directly where the customer operates.



Key Responsibilities

  • Customer Embedding & Data Delivery: Deploy directly into customer environments to understand their domain logic, underlying data pipelines, and architectural constraints. Own end-to-end delivery—from data discovery and schema design to pipeline deployment and model integration—building trust as the customer's lead technical partner.
  • Data Platform & Architectural Modernization: Partner with client business leaders to evaluate legacy technology estates (e.g., monolithic SQL databases, or unmaintained ETL jobs). Lead engineering efforts to refactor legacy data setups into modern lakehouses, event-driven streaming systems, and scalable vector/graph databases.
  • Spec-Driven Development (SDD) for Data & AI: Apply a "spec-first" engineering workflow using Generative AI tools. Write structured specifications (data models, API schemas, transformations, and evaluation metrics) that instruct AI agents to generate production data models, PySpark jobs, data pipelines, and test suites.
  • Agentic AI & LLMOps Implementation: Architect and deploy GenAI workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and autonomous AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or DSPy. Establish robust evaluation frameworks (Evals) for model accuracy, latency, and hallucination control.
  • Production MLOps & Orchestration: Build, deploy, and maintain robust ML training and inference pipelines using tools like MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, or Dagster. Ensure continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) for models and data workflows.
  • Polyglot Data Engineering: Design and audit production code across data-centric languages and frameworks (Python, SQL, Scala, Go, Rust, or TypeScript) based on speed, concurrency, and memory requirements.
  • Client Enablement & Knowledge Transfer: Elevate customer teams by establishing reusable agentic development patterns, modern MLOps practices, data reliability frameworks, and SDD methodologies so systems remain maintainable long after deployment.



Requirements

  • 10+ Years of Experience: Proven track record as a Principal Data Engineer, Lead ML Engineer, or Enterprise Data Architect building and scaling distributed data and ML platforms.
  • Customer-Facing Aptitude: Strong executive presence and communication skills to interface directly with technical teams and business stakeholders under pressure.
  • Data & ML Engineering Depth:
    • Data Infrastructure: Mastery of distributed computing (AWS Glue, Apache Spark, Databricks), modern data warehouses (Redshift, Snowflake, modeling tools (dbt), and data orchestration (Airflow, etc)
    • AI/ML & Vector Architecture: Hands-on experience fine-tuning, evaluating, and deploying LLMs, embedding models, and vector stores
    • Polyglot & Framework Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Python and complex SQL, plus fluency in at least two other languages used in modern backend/data systems (e.g., Scala, Go, Rust, TypeScript).
  • Generative AI & SDD Experience: Demonstrated skill in using natural language and structured specs to guide AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) in generating data pipelines, schemas, and API adapters.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with cloud-native data services on AWS or Azure, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Willingness to Travel: Comfort with occasional travel to customer sites as needed.



Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience migrating legacy, on-premise data warehouses or legacy Hadoop estates to modern cloud lakehouses.

title: Lead Product Manager, Acquisition (scribd.com)
description:
Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd®, Slideshare®, Everand™, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

Culture at Scribd, Inc.

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

We are seeking a Lead Product Manager to own how we acquire new users. While Performance Marketing, SEO, Partnerships, and Brand run our acquisition channels day to day, this role is their product counterpart: you will define which audiences we go after, how we broaden the channel mix over time, and what we need to build to get there, owning the roadmap and engineering investment behind that plan.

The successful candidate combines genuine acquisition expertise with strong product management, and leads through influence helping teams define where acquisition should head next. Your work will directly shape who discovers our products and how durable our growth is.

You will:

  • Own the acquisition roadmap and decide where its engineering investment goes, adapting as the market shifts.

  • Develop and maintain a cross-channel view of where acquisition investment pays off, and bring a clear, evidence-backed recommendation to channel owners and leadership.

  • Build acquisition into the product itself, through referrals, sharing, and other experiences that help existing users bring in new ones.

  • Build and maintain the product capabilities that make each channel more effective, including discoverability, search and AI-answer-engine readiness, channel integrations, and acquisition tracking, working hand in hand with the teams who run those channels.

  • Identify and test new ways to reach users and scale the ones that prove durable.

  • Work closely with Performance Marketing, SEO, Partnerships, and Brand so that product investment and channel investment reinforce one another, with each team continuing to own strategy and execution within its own channel.

  • Set the measurement bar for acquisition, connecting investment to the long-term value of the subscribers it produces rather than traffic or signup volume alone.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Data Science, Product, Marketing and Brand.

You have:

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in product management or growth, with at least 2 years focused on user acquisition, preferably in a consumer subscription business.

  • A hybrid background: a product manager with deep growth marketing experience, or a growth marketer with equally strong product management experience.

  • Working fluency across acquisition channels, including paid search and social, SEO and organic discovery, partnerships, and acquisition driven by the product itself, with a clear point of view on the strengths and tradeoffs of each.

  • The credibility to be a genuine peer to channel experts. You can go deep enough with a paid marketer or an SEO specialist to earn their trust, without needing to run their channel yourself.

  • A track record of building acquisition mechanics into a product, such as growth loops, not only optimizing paid channels.

  • Strong proficiency in data analytics, experimentation, attribution, and funnel optimization, with the ability to tie acquisition decisions to long-term subscriber value rather than cost per acquisition or volume alone.

  • A proven ability to influence without direct authority and build alignment across marketing and product organizations.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward defining a new charter rather than inheriting an established roadmap.

  • Nice to have: experience optimizing for AI search and answer engines, SEO at significant scale, B2C/B2B2C distribution models.

title: Investor Engagement
description:

This role offers you the opportunity to expand and nurture our community of key VIP groups such as institutional investors (LPs) and other key stakeholders in the Private Equity Industry.
Do you want to take part in defining the future of Private Equity? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 500k followers on LinkedIn organising a series of 12 global private equity events every year with 2,000+ GPs, 1,000+ LPs among the attendees.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media () which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

You get the unique opportunity to take ownership of one of our key business areas. You’ll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never-ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • The opportunity of having a real impact - You’ll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.

Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:

  • Identify, maintain and develop long-standing and fruitful relationships with institutional investors who can benefit from the targeted offering of our product and network
  • Accommodate the investment strategy of the LP by facilitating 1:1 meetings with relevant fund managers
  • Support the team to fulfil delivery of our exclusive products such as roundtables, panel sessions, and VIP receptions. This may sometimes require securing an audience that extends beyond our usual definition of institutional investors, such as GPs

Whether you are with or for 2 or 10+ years we believe this position to lay the foundation for a very successful career. Please note that this job does not require any specific previous work experience as training is provided and we are looking to incorporate candidates across different levels of experience. However, we do require you to have a UK work permit.

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:

  • Have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what they do;

  • Take ownership of everything they do, are proactive and follow through on commitments;
  • Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations;
  • Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;

Flexible

The role is onsite, Monday to Friday, based in our offices at Sloane Square. It is essential we work at a fast pace and collaborate in person to create market-leading, unmatched events throughout the calendar year. It will be great to have you as part of our team.

description:

Create what’s next with us. Let’s define tomorrow together.

We’re not just in the business of transporting people. We’re also in the business of moving cargo. As a major provider of air freight services, our Cargo team transports everyday electronics and automotive parts, to perishable goods, life-saving organs, vaccines and even baby formula. And in turn, we help keep businesses, communities, and global economies running. With so many career options – from Marketing to Finance, Logistics to Data Analytics, and more – you can build a career within a career and gain exposure to so many areas of our airline’s important role in the global supply chain. Join our team and watch your uniquely United career journey unfold.

Key Responsibilities:

With United Cargo growing to over $1B in revenue the operational support needs have grown as well. As the airline cargo industry transitions to more data-centric decision making United will need to follow suit to maintain its competitive place as the leader in belly air cargo transport. The Analyst - Cargo Ops Analysis and Budget Management position will utilize dashboards and analytics to drive meaningful changes within the operation. This role focuses on the operational impact on investment in the warehouse and cargo infrastructure. They will provide analytics and reporting to leadership on cargo operational performance, RFS and network performance, and outside vendor performance. Additionally, they will be the lead analyst for the $20M+ cargo capital facility budget, creating business cases and working with finance to direct capital investment within the cargo operation. Furthermore, they will process invoices and payments for the $65M+ RFS budget.

  • Provide analytical support to senior management, specifically managing ad-hoc analysis and action for the $300M United Cargo Operation Budget Strategic Planning.

  • Manage $20M+ cargo facilities capital budget, including creating business cases and shepherding projects through the intensive cargo capital process.

  • Oversee and forecast the $60M+ RFS budget while leading coordination between ops, procurement, and legal on RFS.

  • Create dynamic forecasting models to analyze operational performance including warehouse capacity, plane capacity, network change impact, asset utilization, vendor performance, etc.

Note: This is a Chicago-based hybrid role, with in-office requirements 50% of the time.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics or related discipline OR 4 years of equivalent experience
  • 1+ years' experience in Finance, Economics, Operations, or Analytics
  • Fluent in MS Office Products specifically Excel
  • Knowledge of analytics and data
  • Knowledge of budgets and expenses
  • Presentation skills, specifically in pitching ideas or concepts
  • Ability to perform financial analysis; like DCF, NPV, IRR, etc.
  • Self-starter and motivated individual who can set their own timelines and deliver a quality product
  • Persuasive storyteller with the ability to align stakeholders on a vision
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • 2+ years' experience in Finance, Economics, Operations, or Analytics
  • Experience working in logistics
  • Experience with capital expenditure
  • Data modeling including Excel and Access
  • Knowledge of financial reporting, including capital investments and budget accruals
  • Project Management skill and Continuous Improvement (Six Sigma Lean, PMP, etc.)
  • Analytical Tool Proficiency (SQL, Spotfire, Alteryx, Tableau, STAT, R, etc.)
  • Knowledge of logistics, supply chain, capital processes and funding requests
  • High level analytical skills like statistical modeling
  • Demonstrates an understanding of the capabilities and limitations of generative AI tools and effectively leverages them to support research, analysis, content creation, and problem-solving.
