title: Project Delivery Intern (m/f/d)
description:
terralayr addresses the massive deficit in global energy storage. The over-indexing of electricity generation from renewable energy sources leads to large volatility on the energy grid. The main problem is that wind and solar farms are fluctuating and, by definition, unsteady, there is no sun at night, and it is not always windy. This increases the need for flexibility in the form of battery storage systems to balance the grid in times when supply and demand do not match.
By buying and developing grid-scale storage assets and virtually aggregating them across a layer, we are creating the world's first energy cloud. Imagine AWS for energy. Through the flexibility we secure, we can market flexibility-as-a-service and hedging products/power insurance to utilities, SMEs, and industrial players and create virtual storage capacity for PV and wind farms. We are looking for a Project Delivery Intern (m/f/d) to join our team for a period of ideally 6 to 9 months. This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in project management, project engineering, relations to contractors and other stakeholders, and cross-functional projects within a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
The role will be based in Berlin and allows remote working when needed.
  • You will be working in the project delivery team, which is in charge of building and connecting large scale stand-alone BESS projects to the grid.
  • Support the project delivery team, ensuring smooth progressing of various BESS projects under contracting and under construction from receiving the building permit up to commercial operation.
  • Assist in quality assurance activities, including site visits within Germany.
  • Support in keeping our project management tool up to date and implement new functionalities in alignment with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Take ownership of diverse, cross-functional projects outside existing team scopes, building them from the ground up.
  • Provide administrative support to the team as needed with a focus on documentation management but including other tasks as well.
  • You are currently pursuing or already have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Project Management, Engineering, or any comparable subject from a top tier university or business school and are looking for an internship, ideally 6 to 9 months.
  • You have first work experience in demanding, fast-paced environments.
  • You are a team player, have a hands-on mentality and organisational skills.
  • You are proactive and have a self-starter mindset with excellent organisational, interpersonal and analytical skills.
  • Any previous experience in energy markets, in the development and operation of renewable energy assets or experiences in project management of constructions projects are a plus.
  • Full business proficiency in German (minimum C1) and English.
  • You have a drivers license valid in Germany.
  • Working for a company with a clear mission: A world powered by 100% renewable energy.
  • Learning about the entire lifecycle of BESS projects, which is a market that is booming worldwide for the next 5+ years.
  • Get first-hand experience by working closely with experienced entrepreneurs and senior team members who support your development through mentoring building up and enhancing your personal network.
  • A steep learning curve combined with a lot of space to bring in your own ideas and shape terralayr’s future.
  • Hands-on experience by being able to visit several different project sites in germany, including different battery systems, configurations, and sizes.
  • A strong team culture and lively interactions with the team.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media () which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

title: School Age Group Leader (Part-Time)
description:
Make a difference in a child's afternoon!


Glassboro Child Development Centers is seeking an experienced School Age Group Leader to support our after-school programs. If you enjoy working with children, creating engaging activities, and building positive relationships with families, we would love to meet you!


As a Group Leader, you will help create a safe, welcoming, and engaging environment where school-age children can learn, grow, and thrive.

  • Hours: Approximately 16.25 hours per week
  • Pay Rate: $20.65/hour
  • Potential Weekly Earnings: Up to $335/week
  • Status: Part-Time, Non-Exempt

The School Age Group Leader is responsible for planning, implementing, and evaluating age-appropriate activities while supporting children's social, emotional, language, and physical development.

title: Field Value Engineer - Technology

title: Vice President, Advanced Systems (Business Capture)- Quantum Sensing Solutions
description:
The Vice President (VP), Advanced Systems (AS) is responsible for leading the Advanced Systems function within Infleqtion’s Quantum Sensing Solutions (QSS) Business Unit. The primary focus of this role is to drive business capture excellence in partnership with QSS Business Area (BA) VPs, QSS Program Managers (PMs), Proposal Operations, and Contracts Management. Business capture ownership initiates from a defined point of opportunity qualification and extends through proposal submission, customer negotiation, and contract award. Success in this role requires building a high functioning AS capture team, ensuring that QSS pursuits are strategically aligned to business objectives, competitive positioning of offers to maximize probability of win (Pwin), implementing and following capture best practices for offer development and strategic teaming, appropriately resourcing pursuits and proposals, and strong collaboration within QSS to ensure program success after award.

The AS VP will provide functional leadership of the Advanced Systems Manager (ASM) team, own the QSS capture operating model and associated budgets, lead the gated capture process, own the pursuit and capture pipeline forecast around future bookings and opportunity portfolio, and ensures effective transition from Business Development through Capture to program execution handoff. While the QSS BA VPs retain responsibility for bookings and growth within their respective portfolios, the AS VP owns ensuring excellence in the capture process and management/oversight of the ASM staff. The AS VP will need to directly lead and support captures for highly strategic pursuits or to increase capacity in this opportunity rich environment. This position is an extremely high impact leadership role that directly impacts QSS and Infleqtion growth of the quantum sensing business across national security, civil, and select commercial markets.

Own and drive business captures, capture excellence and governance.

  • Establish a high-performing organization capable of growing a portfolio of leading edge quantum sensing opportunities.
  • Define, mature, and enforce the capture operating model, including roles, responsibilities, gate criteria, capture artifacts, approval authorities, and handoff expectations across the business lifecycle.
  • Lead or oversee capture strategy development for significant opportunities, including win themes, discriminators, customer engagement strategy, customer value, competitive assessment, technical and program solution shaping, pricing posture, teaming strategy, and execution-risk posture.
  • Support bid/no-bid, ROM, proposal, and investment decisions for QSS opportunities, consistent within delegated authority and company approval processes.
  • Ensure awarded programs enter execution with documented technical, cost, schedule, contractual, staffing, supplier, and customer baselines and/or assumptions.
  • Work with Business Area VPs and staff to shape opportunity priorities, capture strategy, customer engagement, teaming approach, and major subcontractor strategies.
  • Ensure proposal technical, management, schedule, pricing, and cost elements are aligned with the approved capture strategy and execution-risk posture.
  • Support customer negotiations, clarifications, BAFO activities, and final proposal revisions as required through contract award.
  • Primary business growth and program development leadership interface within QSS
  • Serve as the senior leadership interface for capture priorities, business opportunity health, gate-review outcomes, and capture-phase forecast content.
  • Partner with Business Area Vice Presidents to deliver bookings consistent with the QSS Operating Plan.
  • Partner with the VP Program Execution, Business Area VPs, Program Managers, Engineering, Finance, Contracts, Legal, Supply Chain, and Quality to ensure proposal assumptions, customer commitments, risk posture, and program baselines are understood and executable.
  • Drive capture lessons learned and feedback loops into BD, capture, proposal, and program execution processes.
  • Establish and maintain a highly collaborative interface with the centralized enterprise Business Development function under the Chief Revenue Officer, ensuring efficient and highly effective transition from opportunity identification, maturation, and qualification into the QSS capture phase.
  • Lead executive-level proposal reviews for strategic or high-value opportunities, ensuring compliance, clarity, competitiveness, realism, and alignment with QSS strategy.
  • Represent QSS capture posture in internal executive reviews, corporate growth discussions, and selected external engagements.

Acquire, cultivate, lead and manage Advanced Systems Manager (ASM) capture management talent.

  • Lead the staffing, process definition, training, performance management, and functional management.
  • Assign ASMs to qualified opportunities based on strategic importance, customer alignment, technical complexity, competitive landscape, resource availability, and execution risk.

Lead and drive capture portfolio operations

  • Manage and maintain the QSS business opportunity database for capture-phase opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain the monthly QSS capture-phase opportunity forecast in partnership with Business Area VPs, Finance/FP&A, Business Development, and Program Execution.
  • Define forecast data structures, reporting cadence, data quality expectations, and integration points with BD-phase and execution-phase portfolio data.
  • Provide capture-phase inputs to the QSS Annual Operating Plan, monthly reforecasts, business reviews, and Board-level reporting as required.
  • Track capture budget allocations and cost, schedule, resources, risks, win probability, proposal readiness, customer milestones, and key decision points across the QSS capture portfolio.

Why Join Us

This role offers the opportunity to shape and scale the growth engine for Infleqtion’s Quantum Sensing Solutions business. The VP Advanced Systems will play a central role in converting advanced quantum sensing technologies into mission-relevant programs, customer partnerships, and long-term business growth.

The successful candidate will have significant visibility with senior leadership, direct influence over QSS strategy and operating-plan performance, and the opportunity to build the capture function required to scale a leading quantum technology portfolio across national security, aerospace, and commercial markets.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, physics, business, or a related technical or business discipline; advanced degree preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in aerospace, defense, intelligence, national security, advanced technology, or related markets, with significant experience in capture leadership, program development, business growth, or program execution.
  • Demonstrated success leading or overseeing complex captures that resulted in contract awards, preferably involving advanced technologies, government customers, and cross-functional proposal teams.
  • Experience managing capture or business-development professionals, program managers, technical teams, or cross-functional pursuit organizations.
  • Strong understanding of U.S. government acquisition processes, contracting vehicles, proposal development, customer engagement, and competitive capture best practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across Business Development, Engineering, Program Execution, Finance, Contracts, Legal, Supply Chain, Proposal Operations, and executive leadership.
  • Experience balancing capture competitiveness with execution realism, including cost, schedule, technical, contractual, and resource risk.
  • Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to brief senior leaders, customers, partners, and Board-level stakeholders.
  • Experience operating in fast-paced, resource-constrained environments where process discipline, judgment, and hands-on leadership are required.
  • U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quantum sensing, photonics, RF systems, precision navigation and timing, inertial sensing, ISR, space systems, or other deep-tech national security, civil, and/or commercial markets.
  • Existing customer, partner, or industry relationships across DoD, IC, NASA, aerospace primes, defense primes, or relevant commercial technology markets.
  • Direct experience with OTA, SBIR/STTR, CRADA, BAAs, FAR/DFARS contracts, cost-share arrangements, and other traditional and non-traditional acquisition mechanisms.
  • Experience building or scaling capture organizations, gated capture processes, opportunity databases, business operating rhythms, and portfolio forecasting systems.
  • Experience in small or mid-sized defense, aerospace, or deep-tech companies transitioning from bespoke R&D programs toward larger recurring programs, production, or standard-product portfolios.
  • Familiarity with AS9100, government contracting compliance, export control, security requirements, and program execution governance.
  • Active security clearance.

Success Metrics

  • Quality, consistency, and discipline of capture execution across QSS qualified opportunities.
  • Achievement of QSS bookings and capture-phase objectives consistent with the QSS Operating Plan.
  • Improved capture win rate, proposal quality, and strategic alignment of awarded work.
  • Effectiveness of Advanced Systems Manager staffing, development, training, assignments, and performance.
  • Timeliness and quality of capture gate reviews, executive decision materials, and approval packages.
  • Accuracy and operational value of the QSS capture-phase opportunity database and monthly capture forecast.
  • Effectiveness of BD-to-capture and capture-to-execution transitions.
  • Demonstrated improvement in the balance of competitive positioning, business attractiveness, and execution-risk acceptability.
  • Quality of collaboration with Business Area VPs, Program Execution, Engineering, Proposal Operations, Finance, Contracts, Legal, Supply Chain, and corporate Business Development organizations and personnel.

description:
Humane Society Silicon Valley (HSSV), a privately funded, 501(c)(3) non-profit, has been serving people and pets in Silicon Valley since 1929. HSSV is a leader in animal welfare through our lifesaving efforts, community programs, and the many ways we are working to move the animal welfare industry forward. Our mission is to save lives, keep families together, and create a better future for pets and their people.

We are a passionate, high-performing team who believes that collaboration is key to our success. Our best work is achieved by leveraging each other’s strengths and creating opportunities for professional growth. Join a team that focuses on our key values of kindness, courage, and impact!

Overview

The Animal Care and Enrichment Technician is an upbeat and enthusiastic team player focused on enhancing the lives of animals and people through maintaining exemplary standards of care for animals in our care. Immediate openings for temporary positions, scheduled 0-40 hours/week depending on availability and department needs. Flexibility in scheduling is desirable.


Key Responsibilities


  • Perform daily cleaning of animal spaces in accordance with “ideal” HSSV model shelter standards. Animal spaces include animal housing, outdoor exercise and storage areas, equipment, dishes, laundry, and items used for transport of animals.
  • Monitor health and behavior status of all animals in assigned areas, adjusting feeding, handling and administering assigned medications as needed to maximize well-being.
  • Maintain welcoming animal spaces, meeting the enrichment needs of the animals. Ensure appropriate housing is clean and ready when an animal needs it.
  • Ensure animals receive daily minimum enrichment activities. Identify animals needing more enrichment, and test and monitor response to the enrichment until their needs are met. Advocate for animals needing intervention outside of animal care.
  • Unload, store and replenish all animal care supplies. Maintain clean and organized supply storage areas and workstations.
  • Assist in the housing of animals from animal control trucks, transport vehicles and public intake.
  • Complete and ensure accuracy of paperwork for animals. Handle data entry for incoming animals and day-to-day activities.
  • Assist and perform humane euthanasia of shelter animals and animals owned by members of the public with compassion and empathy, following best practices and minimizing fear, anxiety and stress. May be asked to complete state certification.
  • Other job duties may be assigned as needed.


Requirements


  • Experience caring for animals a must; shelter or kennel setting a plus.
  • Passion for working with animals and people and must have good judgment skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively and demonstrate an attitude of consideration and courtesy to all members of the public, volunteers and employees.
  • Perform a wide variety of cleaning tasks to a high standard. This position involves a lot of cleaning, including routine exposure to animal excrement and blood. You will be working hands on with a wide variety of dogs, cats, rabbits, rats and guinea pigs.
  • Ability to correctly interpret animal body language and adjust practices to reduce fear, anxiety and stress.
  • Familiarity with computer database applications.
  • Ability to lift and carry weights of up to 50 pounds floor level to waist height frequently.
  • Strong attention to detail and be able to work on your feet all day. Able to bend, squat, lift, walk and stand for the majority of an 8-hour shift.
  • Frequent exposure to loud noise, odors and chemicals.


Work Days and Hours
Hours are flexible and based on organizational need. Hours will include weekends and evening hours, depending on staffing needs.

Candidate Tip

Add "apps.bamboohr.com" to your email contact list so you make sure to receive emails from HSSV regarding your application.

title: Engineer-Hazardous Locations (Hazloc)

This is a fantastic opportunity to grow a versatile career in Product safety pertaining Hazardous (Classified) Locations.

Intertek's Electrical business line applies more than 100 years of product testing expertise to quickly and efficiently help clients meet safety, performance, environmental and quality requirements for every market. Spanning a wide range of industries such as Medical, Lighting, Renewable Energy, HVACR, Appliances & Electronics, Hazardous Locations, Industrial Equipment, Life Safety & Security, IT & Telecom Equipment, Intertek's global network of laboratories employ world-class experts in their fields who deliver quality, accurate testing and certification that continually exceeds our clients' expectations and helps to clear a path for their product's success. The Engineer is responsible for evaluation of product safety pertaining Hazardous (Classified) Locations This position can require travel at 70% of the time.

title: Software Engineer, Fleet Platform
description:
Build the Path Forward

At Path Robotics, we’re building the future of embodied intelligence. Our AI-driven systems enable robots to adapt, learn, and perform in the real world closing the skilled labor gap and transforming industries. We go beyond traditional methods, combining perception, reasoning, and control to deliver field-ready AI that is risk-aware, reliable, and continuously improving through real-world use.

Big, hard problems are our everyday work, and our team of intelligent, humble, and driven people make the impossible possible together.

We are seeking a Platform-focused Software Engineer to join our team. You will bridge the gap between software development and fleet orchestration, building the infrastructure that powers our robots, both locally and in the cloud. This role requires a unique blend of developer skills and platform operations experience to build the tools, automation, and observability systems that ensure our robotic deployments are scalable, secure, and reliable. If you are passionate about solving complex, real-world robotics problems and eager to shape the future of manufacturing, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

Tech you will use:

  • Languages: Python, Terraform HCL, Node.js, Ansible
  • Infrastructure: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform.
  • Fleet & Robotics: OTA (Over-the-Air) software deployment systems, Observability tooling (e.g., Foxglove),
  • Identity & Security: Enterprise AuthN/AuthZ integrations.
  • Collaboration: CI/CD (GitHub Actions), Jira/Confluence, Google Workspace.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Platform Development: Build and scale configuration management processes to support our robotic fleet.
  • Infrastructure Automation: Automate complex infrastructure processes, including enterprise-scale AWS account management and deployments.
  • Fleet Orchestration: Design and maintain OTA (Over-the-Air) software deployment systems to ensure seamless updates across our robotic assets.
  • Identity & Access: Support the migration and management of enterprise-level AuthN and AuthZ for internal and external applications.
  • Observability: Implement and enhance robotics observability tooling (e.g., Foxglove) to improve robot-to-cloud integration and monitoring.
  • Incident Management: Develop automated incident reporting and escalation tooling to proactively identify and resolve production issues.
  • Collaboration: Work alongside product engineers to ensure the platform meets the needs of both the robotic fleet and the applications that interface with it.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 2+ years of experience in production support, development, and DevOps practices.
  • The Hybrid Engineer: You understand the interdependent relationship between product features and the underlying infrastructure. You apply software development best practices (reusable code, automated testing) to platform engineering.
  • Infrastructure Pro: You are proficient in managing cloud environments (AWS) and understand the complexities of multi-account deployments.
  • Robotics Enthusiast: You are excited by the challenge of moving data between robots and the cloud. You have hands-on experience or a strong interest in tools for remote robotics tooling (e.g., Foxglove, Rerun).
  • Security-Minded: You have experience with Enterprise AuthN/AuthZ and understand the importance of secure identity management at scale.
  • Problem Solver: You thrive on troubleshooting complex, distributed issues and are committed to automating your way out of manual tasks.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Daily free lunch to keep you fueled and connected with the team
  • Flexible PTO so you can take the time you need, when you need it
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 6 weeks fully paid parental leave, plus an additional 6–8 weeks for birthing parents (12–14 weeks total)
  • 401(k) retirement plan through Empower
  • Generous employee referral bonuses—help us grow our team!

Who We Are

At Path Robotics we love coming to work to solve interesting and tough challenges but also because our ideas are welcomed and valued. We encourage unique thinking and are dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application process or any part of the hiring process, please contact HR@path-robotics.com. We are committed to providing equal access and will work with qualified individuals to ensure a fair and accessible hiring experience. We will respond to your request within 48 hours.

title: Principal Engineer -Intelligent Document & Context Grounding
description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Principal Software Engineer – Intelligent Document Processing & Context Grounding

Build the AI platform that powers trustworthy enterprise agents.

At UiPath, we're building the next generation of enterprise AI—agents that don't just generate responses, but understand business context, reason over enterprise knowledge, and deliver trustworthy outcomes at scale.

As a Principal Software Engineer, you'll help define and build the Intelligent Document Processing and Context Grounding platforms. Your work will enable AI agents to ingest, understand, retrieve, and reason over large volumes of enterprise documents while maintaining accuracy, security, governance, and performance.

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role for someone who has repeatedly shipped production AI systems and enjoys solving some of the hardest infrastructure challenges in enterprise software.

You'll influence technical direction across multiple teams while remaining deeply involved in architecture, implementation, mentoring, and product delivery.

What You'll Do

Build production AI systems

Design and deliver the core services that power enterprise document understanding, retrieval, knowledge grounding, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) across the UiPath platform.

You'll own systems responsible for:

  • document ingestion

  • parsing and extraction

  • chunking and embedding

  • indexing

  • retrieval

  • knowledge management

  • evaluation

  • answer grounding

Raise the quality bar for enterprise AI

Drive improvements in:

  • retrieval quality

  • answer quality

  • groundedness

  • attribution

  • latency

  • scalability

  • cost efficiency

You'll evaluate emerging techniques, challenge assumptions, and introduce better architectural approaches as AI capabilities continue to evolve.

Solve difficult distributed systems problems

Architect highly available, multi-tenant cloud services that process enormous volumes of enterprise content while maintaining reliability, security, and performance.

You'll work across:

  • distributed services

  • event-driven architectures

  • search platforms

  • vector databases

  • APIs

  • orchestration

  • cloud-native infrastructure

Lead through technical excellence

Principal Engineers at UiPath don't simply review designs—they actively shape them.

You'll:

  • influence architectural decisions across organizations

  • mentor senior engineers

  • participate in critical design reviews

  • establish engineering standards

  • help teams make thoughtful technical tradeoffs

  • raise the quality of engineering across the organization

Partner across Engineering, Product, and Applied AI

Work closely with Product Managers, Applied Scientists, Designers, and Engineering Leaders to turn ambiguous AI opportunities into production capabilities customers rely on every day.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for builders.

Engineers who enjoy taking complex problems, designing elegant systems, and shipping software that customers depend upon.

Successful candidates will typically have:

  • 10+ years building large-scale software systems

  • Significant experience shipping production AI products

  • Strong backend engineering experience in Python and/or C#

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems and cloud-native architectures

  • Experience building scalable APIs, microservices, and event-driven systems

  • Strong understanding of modern retrieval systems including RAG, embeddings, vector search, evaluation, and LLM-powered applications

  • Experience designing reliable, multi-tenant enterprise platforms

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly

  • A track record of mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction beyond their immediate team

Technologies You May Work With

Our technology stack continues to evolve, but experience in areas such as the following is valuable:

  • Python

  • C#

  • Azure (preferred), AWS, or GCP

  • Docker

  • Kubernetes

  • Distributed systems

  • Event-driven architectures

  • Search platforms

  • Vector databases

  • LLMs

  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

  • Embeddings

  • OCR

  • Intelligent Document Processing

  • Knowledge Graphs

  • Evaluation frameworks

What Makes Someone Successful Here

The strongest engineers on this team don't simply know AI—they know how to build AI products.

They enjoy:

  • solving ambiguous technical problems

  • making thoughtful engineering tradeoffs

  • shipping production software

  • collaborating across disciplines

  • mentoring other engineers

  • balancing long-term architecture with short-term execution

Most importantly, they remain hands-on.

This is a role for engineers who still love building.

Why Join UiPath?

Enterprise AI is entering its next phase.

Organizations aren't looking for chatbots—they're looking for AI systems that can reason over their knowledge, operate responsibly, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

At UiPath, you'll help build the platform that makes that possible.

If you're excited by difficult engineering problems, modern AI systems, and building software that thousands of organizations rely on every day, we'd love to talk.

#LI-MH1

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

title: Part specialist and shipper
description:
Join a Growing Company!

We are currently looking for a Part Specialist and Shipper to join our team.

The Alamo Group employs approximately 4,500 people worldwide. In this role, you will be part of the Snow & Ice Canada team, specializing in high-performance snow removal solutions for heavy equipment across North America.

Our Snow & Ice division consists of approximately 350 employees across sites in St-Valérien-de-Milton, Ayer's Cliff, Laval, Caledon, and Calgary, representing the industry-leading Tenco and Everest Equipment brands. Well-established and respected, our group is recognized for innovation, durability, and engineering excellence.

Your Mandate

The Parts Specialist and Shipper is responsible for providing professional customer service and parts sales support by responding to inquiries, identifying replacement parts, preparing quotations, processing orders, and ensuring accurate follow-up with customers and internal teams. The role also supports technical parts research, documentation, inventory accuracy, and daily shipping and receiving activities to ensure timely delivery, operational continuity, and continuous improvement of parts, service, and logistics processes. This role works in a collaborative manner with Parts Specialists and Buyers on a day-to-day basis, as well as with various branches.

Why Join Our Team?

  • Salary: $29 to $34 per hour, depending on experience.
  • Benefits: Group insurance plan
  • Retirement: Group RRSP with a 3% annual employer contribution
  • Referral Program: Earn up to $2,000 per year for successful hires
  • Wellness: Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and telemedicine service
  • Growth: Access to continuous training and genuine opportunities for career advancement

Working Conditions

  • Status: Permanent, full-time (40 hours/week)
  • Schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 3:30 PM
  • Location: Caledon, Ontario

Your Responsibilities

1. Customer Service & Parts Sales Support

  • Respond to customer inquiries (at the counter, by phone, or via email) regarding parts identification, availability, pricing, and lead times.
  • Provide professional, prompt, and solution-oriented service to ensure high customer satisfaction.
  • Support internal teams (service, workshop, sales) in identifying and selecting appropriate parts.
  • Explain basic technical characteristics of parts and propose alternatives when required.

2. Order Management, Quotations & Invoicing

  • Prepare and issue parts quotations to customers.
  • Enter customer orders into the ERP system, ensuring accuracy and proper follow-up.
  • Monitor backorders and proactively communicate lead times to customers.
  • Process parts order invoicing in accordance with established procedures.
  • Ensure pricing accuracy, sales terms compliance, and correctness of customer information.

3. Technical Parts Research & Documentation

  • Perform parts research using catalogs, technical drawings, ERP systems, and other available resources.
  • Document relevant information (part numbers, equivalents, pricing, suppliers) to support future searches.
  • Maintain up-to-date parts data and contribute to continuous improvement of data quality.

4. Warehousing Operations

  • Understand and execute warehousing processes related to receiving, shipping, and location transfers.
  • Support warehousing operations during peak seasons or shipper absences to ensure operational continuity.
  • Coordinate with carriers for pick-ups and deliveries.
  • Perform regular cycle counts and participate in physical inventory audits.

5. Processes, Compliance & Continuous Improvement

  • Apply and adhere to established policies and procedures related to parts, inventory, and customer service.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of parts management, service, and logistics processes.
  • Ensure data accuracy in ERP systems and related tools.
  • Participate in branch- or group-level improvement projects and initiatives as required.

Candidate Profile

Education & Experience:

  • High school diploma (or equivalent) required.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in customer service, parts management, procurement, or logistics.
  • Vocational or technical training in industrial mechanics, automotive mechanics, electromechanics, or a related field (strong asset).
  • Training in parts management, logistics, supply chain, or after-sales service is an asset.
  • Ability and willingness to participate in ongoing training provided by the company or suppliers (products, parts catalogs, new systems).
  • Forklift certification and operating experience (asset).
  • Experience in a parts environment (industrial equipment, specialized vehicles, or automotive) strongly preferred.
  • Experience in an industrial or after-sales environment (asset).

Skills & Requirements:

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).

title: Program Mgr, Oncology and Ambulatory Imaging UVACH
description:
Program Manager, Oncology and Ambulatory Imaging

Job Code: US

We are welcoming a new era in healthcare where achieving good health is just the beginning. At UVA Health Northern VA & Culpeper, we believe in caring for the whole person by getting to know – and making connections with – our patients. By combining the talent and expertise of our people, the breadth of capabilities across our system, and our commitment to helping our communities get better and stay healthy, we are improving the patient experience.

As a UVA Health Northern VA & Culpeper team member, you will have a voice in patient care decisions, support the most advanced medical technologies and feel a strong sense of satisfaction from making a difference in people’s lives every day.

JOB TYPE

Classification: Exempt

Supervises Positions: N/A

JOB SUMMARY

The Program Manager is responsible for the supporting the oversight, development and implementation of quality improvement and patient safety initiatives for oncology and ambulatory imaging services, to include policy and procedure development and compliance for related regulatory agencies including, but not limited to Commission on Cancer (CoC), Foundation for the Accreditation of Cellular Therapy (FACT), National Accreditation Program for Breast Centers (NAPBC), American College of Radiology (ACR) etc. The position is also responsible for the analysis of quality and performance improvement data through coordination of information including data collection, analysis and trending of required regulatory indicators, clinical quality and review activities, external agency review and other select clinical outcomes measurement. This position provides expertise in maintaining compliance with requirements of regulatory and accreditation agencies specific to oncology. This position serves to educate all team members and physicians throughout the health system on regulatory/accrediting requirements to promote readiness and compliance.

Responsibilities:

Planning overseeing and evaluating regional institutional or statewide health education programs.

Outreach to build the cancer service line and ambulatory imaging referrals base.

Leading teams to develop programmatic growth utilizing strategic planning principles.

Work collaboratively with administrators, managers, the interdisciplinary team and physicians to identify and enhance

strategic clinical issues, through the Be Safe methodology for problem solving.

Support workgroups through planning, facilitation, task execution, and/or communication support. Implementation of new protocols and procedures. Assist workgroups with content and research support to progress the project. As initiatives progress, may engage with workgroups to identify external project support.

Performance outcome deliverables include, but not limited to; quality, safety, patient satisfaction, service, operational

efficiency, and process improvements.

Develop and review analytical work products for accuracy, completeness and help frame the analysis for leadership decision making.

Independently retrieve, interpret, and analyze data from a wide variety of sources.

Maintains a state of survey readiness which includes clinical audits, mock surveys and adherence to infection control

practices.

Coordinates interdisciplinary team rounds/meetings and participates as needed.

Provides effective project consultation and facilitation to ensure projects meet goals and objectives as defined by leadership.

Prepare and share reports with leadership to review status, important issues, and barriers that impact progress of all active and upcoming projects. May draw upon healthcare knowledge, trends, and experiences to execute tasks, inform analysis and evaluate issues for leadership discussion. Assists clinical and programmatic oncology leadership and staff to identify opportunities and develop action plans to drive improvement of patient care, treatment and services. Provides expertise and supports the activities of process improvement sub-committees.

Ensures compliance with current legislative/regulatory requirements; serves as liaison with related regulatory agencies.

Provides educational support to all departments/units in the areas of oncology quality improvement, patient safety,

accreditation standards and other regulatory standards. Maintains knowledge of and expertise in requirements related to regulatory policies and bylaws. Provides education of multi-disciplinary team members in regard to policies/protocols and forms.

Develops/revises and maintains change control for all oncology regulatory forms, policies, protocols and guidelines.

Works to improve functionality of data and related databases.

Develops action plans and coordinates improvement projects to support best practices, regulatory compliance and strategic initiatives.

Education, Program Operations, & Support

  • Lead planning, implementation, and evaluation of regional oncology education programs across multiple clinical sites (Culpeper, Gainesville, Prince William and Haymarket).
  • Develop and manage comprehensive educational content aligned with institutional regulatory standards (CoC, NAPBC, FACT).
  • Conduct needs assessments and tailor programming to support quality improvement and patient safety initiatives.
  • Assess educational needs to support compliance and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Provide resources for oncology staff to promote readiness and quality of care.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance patient safety and care delivery through education and awareness.

Marketing & Promotion

  • Partner with the oncology leadership team, ambulatory imaging team and UVA Health Marketing to develop and execute communication strategies for service line programs.

  • Lead the creation and dissemination of promotional content to increase awareness of cancer center programs, including support groups, wellness webinars, navigation services, and survivorship care.

  • Coordinate regular updates of marketing collateral such as brochures, flyers, digital displays, social media content, and email newsletters tailored to patients, caregivers, and providers.

  • Develop and maintain a promotional calendar for events, program launches, and health observances (e.g., Breast Cancer Awareness Month).

  • Track engagement metrics and assess outreach effectiveness to optimize messaging and reach.

  • Graphic Design & Content Development
  • Design visually engaging materials using tools such as Canva, UVA Health brand site, or institutional templates.
  • Develop branded content that aligns with institutional guidelines and resonates with diverse patient populations in our catchment area
  • Support video and photo shoots highlighting patient stories, provider spotlights, or new services.

Community Engagement

Assist in planning and promoting educational events, and awareness campaigns.

Develop internal toolkits or referral guides to increase clinical staff awareness of navigation and supportive care programs.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education: 4 Year/Bachelor's Degree. Master’s Degree preferred.

Experience: Two years of project management, quality or regulatory experience required; project management, quality or regulatory experience preferred. Experience or training in principles of quality improvement and regulatory compliance preferred. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills and experience in utilizing work processing, spreadsheets, and clinical systems/databases required.

Licensure: N/A

Additional Skills/Requirements Required: Demonstrates effective communication skills. Autonomous, self-starter with the ability to make independent decisions. Organized with effective time management skills. Detail oriented with ability to facilitate change and affect positive results. Proficient in computer/web-based tools.

Additional Skills/Requirements Preferred: N/A

The incumbent may be asked to perform additional duties as assigned.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Physical Demand Code: Medium to Heavy Physical Demand: The job requires constant standing, frequently walking, and bending/stooping. Proficient communicative, auditory, and visual skills. Attention to detail and ability to write legibly. Ability to lift/push/pull 100 lbs. For any weight over 35 lbs., use Safe Handling Equipment. This job description may not include all assigned duties, responsibilities, or aspects of the job described. It may be amended at any time at the sole discretion of UVA Community Health.

OTHER

May require the use of safety equipment, such as HEPA mask, for infection prevention: Yes

On call responsibilities as directed: Yes

Ability to travel between campus buildings, remote facilities, and out of town as needed: Yes

Compensation Information

The base compensation range for this role is $45.29 - $74.20 hourly

Individual compensation will be determined by the selected candidate's qualifications, previous work experience, and/or education. Please note that credit for prior experience is applicable to full-time and part-time positions only and does not apply to PRN positions. The pay range does not include any applicable incentive compensation programs such as shift differentials, clinical ladders, or other incentives that may be available for eligible positions.

title: Budget Technician
description:
Title: Budget Technician
Location: Atlanta, GA
Schedule: Full-time, onsite Monday–Friday
Salary: $30.00–$35.00 per hour

KMRG, LLC (KMRG) is a federal services company that hires talented professionals to support Government agencies and the communities they serve. We are hiring a Budget Technician to join our team and provide onsite financial and administrative support to the U.S. Attorney’s Office, Northern District of Georgia, in Atlanta, GA.
In this role, you will support the Administration Division by recording and adjusting financial obligations, reviewing invoices and payment requests, processing payments and reimbursements, maintaining financial records, and providing backup support for the office’s travel program.

This position is a strong fit for someone with Government accounting, budgeting, accounts-payable, or financial-management experience who is organized, detail-oriented, comfortable researching discrepancies, and able to manage sensitive financial information. Experience using the Department of Justice’s Unified Financial Management System is strongly preferred, but candidates with experience using other federal or state financial systems are also encouraged to apply.

Applications will be reviewed as they are received. Apply today!

RESPONSIBILITIES
Budget & Obligation Support
  • Receive obligating documents for expenses incurred by the District
  • Review obligation requests for accuracy, completeness, required documentation, and regulatory compliance
  • Confirm expenses are charged to appropriate appropriation, budget category, account classification, and funding code
  • Verify that sufficient funds are available before recording an obligation
  • Assist with assigning requisition numbers and prevent the issuance of duplicate numbers
  • Record one-time and recurring funding obligations in the Unified Financial Management System
  • Process litigation, non-litigation, expert-witness, and other funding requests
  • Make timely adjustments to obligations to maintain accurate and current fund balances
  • Monitor obligation-tracking procedures
  • Assist employees with completing requests for obligation
Invoice & Payment Processing
  • Prepare and process vouchers, invoices, claims, and other requests for payment
  • Review invoices for validity, mathematical accuracy, completeness, and required approvals
  • Verify that payment requests include the proper approving authority and receiving signature
  • Match invoices and payment requests to the applicable obligating documents
  • Confirm that funds have been properly obligated and remain available
  • Verify Federal Tax Identification Numbers, Social Security Numbers, and other required payee information
  • Select the appropriate payment method through the Unified Financial Management System
  • Schedule payments in accordance with Prompt Payment Act requirements
  • Help prevent late-payment interest penalties by processing payments within required timeframes
  • Research and resolve disputed invoices, payment questions, and missing information
Vendor Payment Support
  • Schedule electronic funds transfers, Treasury payments, and other authorized payment methods
  • Ensure payments are processed from original invoices or properly certified duplicate documents
  • Confirm that each payment has been properly reviewed and approved
  • Maintain accountability for payment documentation and related financial records
  • Communicate with vendors, attorneys, employees, and Government personnel to resolve discrepancies
  • Research missing, incomplete, or inconsistent payment information
  • Coordinate with Department of Justice and Executive Office for United States Attorneys personnel as needed
  • Notify financial-management staff when payment or documentation discrepancies are identified
Travel Program Support
  • Provide backup support to the Budget Officer, analysts, and financial technician for the travel program
  • Explain travel procedures, required forms, receipts, and supporting documentation to employees
  • Assist employees with interpreting and applying applicable travel regulations
  • Review travel authorizations for accuracy, completeness, and appropriate per diem rates
  • Analyze discrepancies and work directly with employees to reconcile travel documents
  • Review travel vouchers and confirm that required receipts and supporting records are included
  • Assign appropriate accounting and funding codes to travel documents
  • Enter travel-voucher information into the Unified Financial Management System
  • Verify travel entries for accuracy and consistency with the authorized obligation
  • Generate reports to confirm travel allocations and funding activity
  • Process travel vouchers for payment
  • Audit travel vouchers for compliance with applicable regulations, policies, and procedures
Financial Records Management
  • Develop and maintain an organized payment-file system for obligations, vouchers, and invoices
  • Track pending invoices and determine whether payments have already been issued
  • Research payment records to help prevent duplicate payments
  • Maintain files for open, pending, adjusted, and completed obligations
  • Purge or close files in accordance with approved procedures
  • Maintain electronic financial-management payment files under the Administration Division file plan
  • Recommend updates or improvements to financial filing and tracking practices
  • Maintain logs, manuals, publications, and other administrative reference materials
  • Protect financial, employee, vendor, and personally identifiable information
Reporting & Administrative Support
  • Develop and maintain working knowledge of the Unified Financial Management System
  • Prepare reports regarding financial obligations, payments, travel, and related activity
  • Research financial-system problems and take corrective action as appropriate
  • Identify routine and complex problems and develop workable solutions
  • Draft correspondence regarding bills, rebates, payments, and reimbursable agreements
  • Prepare memoranda, reports, and other fiscal or administrative documents
  • Respond to employee questions regarding established financial and administrative procedures
  • Use spreadsheets and databases to enter, revise, sort, calculate, retrieve, and report information
  • Review documents for proper format, spelling, grammar, punctuation, and accuracy
  • Use word-processing software to prepare correspondence and other written materials

REQUIRED BACKGROUND
  • Experience and expertise performing financial and administrative services (e.g., recording obligations, reviewing invoices, processing payments, maintaining financial records, and supporting travel vouchers)
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
  • Ability to use spreadsheets, databases, and word-processing software to enter, review, calculate, retrieve & report info
  • Ability to review financial docs for accuracy, completeness, required approvals, and compliance
  • Ability to research discrepancies and develop appropriate solutions
  • Ability to make responsible decisions on short notice and adapt to unexpected developments
  • Ability to maintain confidential information and records
  • Valid state driver’s license
  • Must live within the general geographic commuting radius of the USAO office
  • U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain favorable adjudication for the required background investigation

PREFERRED BACKGROUND
  • Experience using the Department of Justice Unified Financial Management System
  • Experience creating obligations, processing invoices, reconciling payments, or processing travel vouchers in UFMS
  • Experience using federal financial-management systems such as Momentum, Oracle Federal Financials, CGI Momentum, SAP, Delphi, Pegasys, or PRISM financial modules
  • Federal budget, accounting, accounts-payable, or financial-technician experience
  • Federal travel-program experience using systems such as ConcurGov, E2 Solutions, ETS2, GovTrip, or the Defense Travel System
  • State-government accounting, budgeting, or financial-management experience
  • Experience supporting a Department of Justice component, U.S. Attorney’s Office, or other federal agency

EDUCATION
One of the following is required:
  • Two-year degree in accounting
or
  • Four-year degree in finance, business, banking, economics, or a related field

LOCATION
  • 75 Ted Turner Drive SW, Suite 600, Atlanta, GA 30303

TRAVEL
  • Travel within the Northern District of Georgia may be required
  • Occasional travel outside the District may be required
  • Travel must be authorized in advance by appropriate Government personnel

WORK HOURS
  • Full-time, Monday–Friday; 8:00 AM–4:30 PM; 8 working hours per day with a 30-minute lunch period

  • 5+ years of program or project management experience in a product led organization, with a track record of delivering complex product and engineering initiatives.

  • Demonstrated experience driving software delivery in close partnership with product and engineering teams.

  • Hands-on experience running Agile/Scrum delivery and managing programs in Jira (boards, sprints, backlog management, and reporting).

  • Excellent written and verbal communication — able to tailor the message to engineers and executives alike.

  • A structured, proactive, and outcome-oriented mindset; comfortable driving clarity in ambiguous situations.

  • Strong stakeholder management and the ability to influence without direct authority.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a fast-moving product or SaaS environment.

  • Familiarity with coordinating adjacent IT or Salesforce work as it intersects with product delivery.

  • PMP, CSM, SAFe, or equivalent certification.

  • Experience introducing or scaling program management practices in a growing organization.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: You understand the org's initiatives, stakeholders, and delivery cadence, and you've established a clear, trusted source of truth for program status.

  • 3 months: Cross-functional initiatives are running on predictable rhythms, risks are surfaced early, and leadership has reliable visibility into progress.

  • Ongoing: You're the person the VP of Technology and team leads count on to keep the organization aligned, accountable, and delivering.

The salary for this role is: $80/hr

title: Legal Ops Internship
description:
Who we are

Heritage is building the Modern Investment Office, supporting some of the most prominent families globally to achieve their capital enhancement and preservation goals.

Our vision is to help clients build enduring wealth across generations by combining institutional-grade investment sourcing with personalized portfolio construction, cutting-edge technology, and deep sector expertise. We aim to make sophisticated private market opportunities and modern wealth solutions more transparent, connected, and actionable.

Our team comprises of a diverse international group of individuals from leading organisations and with diverse backgrounds, including private equity, venture capital, banking, software development, law, and entrepreneurship. We are committed to attracting top-notch talent and providing opportunities for growth and development based on their individual strengths and interests.

Your role as Legal Ops Intern

As a Legal Ops Intern, you will be part of the Regulatory Affairs and Compliance function that is responsible for designing and building the policies, procedures, and contractual infrastructure of our regulated entities across Europe. You will work closely with our Head of Regulatory Affairs and other senior members of the legal, compliance, and operations teams, to learn how to approach complex multi-jurisdictional regulatory questions and contribute to well-researched, structured solutions in a rapidly evolving and challenging environment (where we value precision, intellectual honesty, and a curious mindset).

You will
  • Assist in drafting policies, procedures, and governance documents under the supervision of the Regulatory Affairs team;
  • Support the authorisation / passporting workstreams, helping gather and organise documentation for regulatory filings;
  • Carry out legal and regulatory research across FCA, AMF, ESMA, and other relevant frameworks (AIFMD, MiFID II, AML/CFT, etc.);
  • Help map and track regulatory obligations across group entities to support consistency and harmonisation;
  • Contribute to maintaining contractual templates, internal manuals, registers, and compliance trackers;
  • Support day-to-day compliance tasks, including helping prepare memos, briefing notes, and materials for senior management.

What we are looking for....

Someone who, beyond academic background, brings the right mindset and personal attributes to thrive in a fast-moving regulatory environment:
  • Attention to detail: Read carefully, proofread, and cross-check documents for internal consistency (defined terms, cross-references, schedules). Catch issues others miss — and flag them early.
  • Self-motivated: Bring energy and ownership to every task. Don't wait to be chased: follow up, hit deadlines, ask for guidance when stuck, and raise risks before they become problems.
  • Critical thinking: Understand the "why" behind every task. Challenge approaches constructively — and never bring a problem without at least one proposed solution.
  • Team working: collaborate openly across functions and jurisdictions. Share knowledge, give credit, integrate feedback, and put team wins above personal visibility — especially under pressure.
In addition, the ideal candidate:
  • Is a law or master's student (or recent graduate) in Law — ideally with some interest in financial services / asset management regulation.
  • Has a genuine curiosity about the regulation of investment firms, AIFMs, and wealth/asset management, and is eager to learn how rules translate into operational reality.
  • Any previous exposure to the financial services, asset management, or FinTech sector is a plus.
  • Is fluent in English; working proficiency in French and/or Italian is a nice plus.

What we offer

A paid internship in the heart of Milan, starting in September and lasting six enriching months, will help shape you into a well-rounded professional. You will join an international team from 10+ nationalities whom you will interact with daily and at quarterly team-building events.

  • Work with some of the best people in the industry. We are an industry-leading team, with Professionals from top organizations, such as Carlyle, CD&R, etc.
  • Unmatched exposure to both external stakeholders (entrepreneurs, investors, etc.) and internal ones

Join us for an experience that combines professional growth with a positive work environment. Your journey begins here!

At Heritage, we are proud to have a diverse team representing over 15 nationalities, with all communication conducted in English. We are deeply committed to providing equal opportunities and work actively to remove potential biases in our hiring process by involving a Hiring Committee in all decision-making.
